Title: Junior Business Information Analyst - Madrid
Description:
El analista de datos I interactúa con equipos globales y multifuncionales de toda la organización. Trabaja con el personal de auditoría de campo y otros analistas de datos para definir y completar proyectos de conversión de datos del cliente según los requisitos de la auditoría mediante el desempeño de las siguientes funciones.


Tasks


• Realiza tareas de análisis que utilizan conocimientos de negocios y contabilidad para dirigir o desarrollar la programación necesaria para proporcionar la auditoría requerida herramientas al sitio de auditoría.

• Convierte datos de clientes a formatos estándar PRGX aprovechando la programación SQL basada en parámetros.

• Garantice la integridad de los datos verificando la legibilidad de los datos, la estructura de los datos, el contenido de los datos, el alcance de los datos, etc., ayudando así a eliminar los problemas relacionados con los datos dentro del proceso de flujo de datos comerciales.

• Bajo supervisión general, responde a solicitudes del personal de auditoría para conversión de datos, informes estándar, informes no estándar y soporte relacionado. cuestiones que incluyen análisis y programación.

• Ayuda a otros miembros del equipo a evaluar, diagnosticar y corregir problemas de aplicaciones comerciales.

• Proporciona soporte de programación a otros miembros del personal sobre cuestiones de diseño de sistemas empresariales, aplicaciones personalizadas y cuestiones de programación, según sea necesario.

• Aumenta el conocimiento de las aplicaciones PRGX y amplía el conocimiento técnico a través de publicaciones comerciales, cursos y demostraciones.

• Amplía la comprensión de las prácticas, técnicas y auditorías comerciales de PRGX.

• Contribuye al éxito de la organización ayudando a otros a lograr resultados laborales; aprender nuevas habilidades necesarias para el equipo; mejorar la reutilización del código; encontrar nuevas formas de ayudar al equipo


Requirements


• Licenciatura (BA) de un colegio o universidad de cuatro años; o de uno a tres años de experiencia y/o capacitación relacionada; o combinación equivalente de educación y experiencia.

• Más de 1 año de experiencia en un entorno de oficina, análisis de datos y/o conversión relacionada.

• Experiencia en MS SQL y T­SQL; análisis de bases de datos relacionales

• Se valorará la exposición/conocimiento de formatos JSON y plataformas de almacenamiento de objetos.

• La exposición a varios formatos de archivos como delimitados, posicionales y EBCDIC es una ventaja

• Exposición/conocimiento de soluciones de informes como Power BI

• Conocimiento de scripting Python básico para automatizar tareas.

• Conocimientos de contabilidad o auditoría financiera; la exposición a los sistemas financieros (SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft, JD Edwards, etc.) es una ventaja

• Sólidas habilidades analíticas y de comunicación.

• Experiencia con productos MS Office.

• Capacidad para trabajar en un entorno de equipo dinámico y de alto rendimiento

Title: Data Analyst - RDT Workforce Enablement
Description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Data Analyst - RDT Workforce Enablement

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Data Analyst - Data Products & Insights Team in Workforce Enablement - is responsible for leading, translating business challenges into analytical problems, and delivering data-driven insights and actionable recommendations to stakeholders. This role involves independently conducting comprehensive data analysis, preparing detailed reports, and presenting findings to various business units to inform strategic and operational decisions. In this role, you will act as a key liaison between business units and data engineering teams, ensuring that data structures, analytical logic, and business definitions are documented, clearly understood, and leveraged for maximum strategic impact.

The opportunity:


Scope / (Content Leadership): Leads data analysis projects and delivers high-value insights. Works independently on specific projects from inception to completion
Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex business problems using data. Validates insights and ensures their accuracy with no supervision required
Stakeholder Management: Manages direct communication with key business stakeholders regarding analytical findings. Engages proactively with broader business units to thoroughly understand their data needs.Facilitates discovery workshops with stakeholders to capture business rules, define key performance indicators (KPIs), and translate them into technical specifications for implementation.
Impact/Strategy: Drives medium- to large-sized projects that directly influence business decisions. Ensures that analysis projects are closely aligned with broader business strategy and goals. Documents As-Is and To-Be data flows and business processes, ensuring clear traceability between business decisions, reporting outputs, and underlying data sources.
Complexity / (Product Size): Handles more complex datasets and multifaceted analysis tasks.
Business / Technical ability: Applies strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate complex insights effectively. Demonstrates proficiency in advanced data analysis techniques


Who you are:

Education / Experience

Demonstrated experience independently conducting comprehensive data analysis
Proven track record of translating business challenges into analytical problems and delivering actionable, data-driven recommendations
Experience acting as a standalone role between data teams and business functions, ensuring insights inform strategic and operational decisions



Technical Skills

Strong expertise in advanced data analysis techniques and handling more complex datasets
Ability to independently validate insights and ensure high data accuracy
Proficient in utilizing data visualization tools to develop compelling visualizations and comprehensive dashboards



Additional Qualifications

Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to manage direct communication with key business stakeholders and present findings to various business units
Strong analytical mindset with a focus on ensuring complex insights are understood by non-technical audiences and leveraged for maximum impact


What you get:

Salary range 14,175 - 26,325 PLN gross based on the employment contract.


Annual bonus payment based on your performance
Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.)
Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available)
Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose)
Vacation subsidy available
Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time)
Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice)
Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport
Stock share purchase additions
Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!


Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

Title: RevOps Performance Analyst
Description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About The Role

We're looking for a RevOps Performance Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help bridge the gap between raw data and strategic execution and be part of the GTM engine as we scale our automated spend management solutions across Europe. If you're excited about turning ambiguity into actionable insights and are passionate about FinTech and data-driven growth, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who You'll Be Working With And Reporting To

You'll report to our Manager, Revenue Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Our team of RevOps specialists is highly collaborative and dedicated to optimising the entire revenue lifecycle. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data Engineering and Finance to ensure a single source of truth for all company-wide KPIs

What You'll Be Doing

As a RevOps Performance Analyst, you will:


Create holistic insights across the entire revenue funnel (Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success) to identify bottlenecks and conversion opportunities. Interpret ambiguous GTM questions and translate them into measurable metrics and analytical approaches.
Develop and maintain automated dashboards that act as the "Single Source of Truth" for GTM KPIs, including CAC, LTV, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and pipeline velocity.
Challenge or refine requests when definitions, logic, or business relevance are unclear. Recommend improved metrics or analytical approaches when they better address the underlying business need.
Design analytics data models and tables to ensure data integrity across the tech stack (CRM, Billing, BI tools), ensuring all data is stored and transferred securely. Identify the correct system of record and reconcile discrepancies across sources. Partner with Data & Analytics when data engineering or architecture support is required.
Support senior management and our C-Level stakeholders with data-driven recommendations on resource allocation and GTM strategy; highlighting risks, trade-offs, and expected impact.
Build and continuously improve predictive models for sales forecasting and churn propensity to provide actionable forward-looking insights.
Analyse the impact of key variables in the sales process—such as discounting behaviours, lead routing efficiency, and promotion effectiveness—to drive operational excellence.


What You Bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:


A solid understanding of SQL, data modeling and predictive statistical techniques
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate messy business questions into clean, measurable metrics
A passion for challenging the status quo and refining logic when business relevance is unclear
Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise high-impact tasks for senior leadership
Experience with SaaS metrics (NRR, Gross Margin, Magic Number)
A background in RevOps, Sales Ops or Strategic Finance within a high-growth environment


Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:


You love the detective work of finding out why a conversion rate dropped and proposing the fix
You enjoy being the bridge between technical data engineers and non-technical sales leaders
You want to see your analytical models directly influence the company's GTM strategy in real-time


This role is not a good fit for you if:


You prefer working on static reports rather than dynamic, evolving business problems
You are uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or senior management when the data tells a different story
You prefer a siloed environment where you don't have to worry about the upstream or downstream impact of data


How You'll Develop In This Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:


Lead a full-funnel audit to drive impact in lead-to-close efficiency
Collaborate with data engineering to improve our underlying RevOps data architecture and dbt models
Grow your skills in executive presence, presenting quarterly performance deep-dives to our GTM leadership


We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on larger strategic projects, stepping into a leadership track, or mastering advanced data engineering skills within the RevOps domain

Please note: You will need to be physically based in one of the locations listed on the advert with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of our locations.

Show me the benefits!


💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice
❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:


Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.
Hiring Manager Interview: A 45- minutes interview with the Hiring Manager to go deeper on your experience and how your profile can adapt to the role
Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present it during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
Final Interview: Final conversation with a Senior Leader


Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a vast numbers of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:


We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.


About Your Application


English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Title: Senior Analyst - Loyalty Analytics (All Genders)
Description:
Company Description

With over 25 years’ experience, plus the same enormous passion and ambition we had on day-one, we’re trailblazers in the pet e-commerce industry. Our solutions make over 12 million customers genuinely happier – and that’s something we really care about. We work together to continually adapt; embracing change and the challenges it brings so that we can keep doing better. Join us and discover a place where your potential meets your passion for pets. That’s the power of plus.

Job Description

As a Senior Analyst, Loyalty Analytics, you will be the primary analytics partner for Zooplus' Loyalty Product and Loyalty Business teams. You will translate business questions into analytical frameworks, measure the impact of loyalty initiatives, and deliver actionable insights that support decision-making and program growth.

You will own key loyalty measurement frameworks, define and monitor program KPIs, and ensure the loyalty analytics backlog remains aligned with business priorities and company strategy. This role combines hands-on analytics expertise with functional leadership and stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities


Translate business questions into analytical approaches and actionable insights that support loyalty program decisions.
Measure the impact and incrementality of loyalty initiatives through experimentation, cohort analysis, and performance evaluation.
Define, maintain, and evolve KPIs that measure loyalty program performance, customer engagement, retention, and customer value.
Build dashboards, reporting solutions, and measurement frameworks that enable data-driven decision-making.
Act as the primary analytics partner for Loyalty Product and Loyalty Business teams, providing analytical guidance and recommendations.
Own and prioritize the loyalty analytics backlog, ensuring it remains aligned with business priorities, loyalty program objectives, and company strategy.
Influence product and business decisions through data-driven recommendations and clear communication of analytical findings.
Promote analytics best practices and continuously improve measurement methodologies, reporting standards, and data quality.


What Success Looks Like

Within Your First 6-12 Months, You Will


Become the trusted analytics partner for Loyalty Product and Loyalty Business teams.
Establish and maintain a scalable KPI framework for monitoring loyalty program performance.
Deliver robust measurement approaches for key loyalty initiatives and product enhancements.
Ensure the loyalty analytics backlog is prioritized and aligned with evolving business priorities.
Deliver actionable insights that influence product decisions, customer experience improvements, and program growth.
Build reporting and dashboard solutions that increase visibility of loyalty program performance and enable self-service decision-making.


Why You'll Love Working With Us


Ownership of a strategically important business area.
Opportunity to influence the future of customer loyalty across multiple markets.
Close collaboration with product and business leaders.
A highly data-driven environment where insights directly shape decisions and customer experience.
An international team focused on continuous improvement and customer value.
Opportunities to grow both your analytical expertise and functional leadership capabilities.


Qualifications

Must-Have Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or another quantitative field.
5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, product analytics, customer analytics, loyalty analytics, or a related field.
Advanced SQL proficiency, including writing complex queries to analyze large-scale customer and transaction datasets.
Experience using Python for analytics, automation, or statistical analysis.
Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar data visualization tools.
Proven experience translating business questions into analytical frameworks and actionable recommendations.
Strong experience delivering insights that drive measurable business outcomes.
Experience defining KPIs, building dashboards, and developing reporting frameworks for business stakeholders.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision-making across product and business teams.
Experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations to non-technical audiences.
Fluency in English.


Nice-to-Have Requirements


Experience working with loyalty programs, customer retention, subscription products, membership models, or customer lifecycle analytics.
Experience measuring incrementality through experimentation, causal inference, uplift measurement, or cohort-based methodologies.
Experience with Adobe Analytics.
Experience in e-commerce, retail, subscription, or digital product businesses.


Additional Information

Headquartered in Munich, with offices across Madrid, Krakow, Wroclaw, London and Vienna, we collaborate because we genuinely love working together - so you’ll be at the heart of an incredible, multinational team. We trust each other to get the job done, which means you’ll benefit from hybrid working, spending 60% of your time in the office and 40% at home. There’s an option to work for 20 days abroad in approved countries too.

Add to that development opportunities that help you to shape your own career path, excellent training and support, wellbeing offers, subsidised transport or bike leasing, plus 20% discount across all our products, and you’ll begin to get a sense of what sets us apart. Find out more about the specific benefits at your local office in our blog posts.

A note on compensation: We believe in being transparent about salary ranges. The range shown reflects the full scope that the role can grow into over time, depending on experience, skills, and impact. Most offers are positioned around the midpoint of the range, ensuring a fair and consistent approach across our teams.

At zooplus, we believe in equal opportunity and support everyone to fulfil their potential. We recognise the power of listening and learning from each other and embrace diversity and inclusion of all.

Title: Senior Product Analyst
Description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About Us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience.

By joining us as a Senior Product Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in helping Product teams understand how users behave in our product, identify the most important opportunities, and turn those insights into roadmap decisions.

HOW You Will Contribute To The Company

As a Senior Product Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Product topics (6+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).


You will help Product teams deeply understand user behaviors across Pennylane’s frontend experiences, using tools such as Amplitude and our data warehouse to identify adoption patterns, friction points, opportunities, and risks.
You will turn behavioral data into clear, strategic insights that help Product leaders decide what to build, improve, simplify, or stop.
You will be a real sparring partner for Product leaders, feeding their strategy by anticipating the most important questions, framing the right analyses, and translating findings into product roadmap recommendations.
You will contribute to developing a stronger product measurement mindset across Product, Design, Engineering, and Data: helping teams define success metrics, clarify what needs to be measured, and think about measurement earlier in the product development process.
You will partner with the relevant owners on tracking and implementation when needed, ensuring measurement choices remain pragmatic, actionable, and connected to product decisions.
You will contribute to our self‑service approach to analytics by understanding Product partners’ needs and promoting a data‑driven culture. You will contribute directly to data models in the data warehouse (using dbt) used by Product teams.


WHAT You Can Expect From Your Life At Pennylane

Within one month:


You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.
You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.
You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of the Product area you support.


Within 3 months:


You will be fully in charge of supporting a Product area, prioritizing your topics with its decision makers and helping them connect user behavior insights to roadmap choices.
You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).
You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.


Within 6 months:


You will proactively contribute to the Product area’s roadmap by surfacing strategic opportunities from behavioral analyses.
You will work with Product, Engineering and Data practitioners to improve how we measure product success.
You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.


And beyond: the data team will continue growing with the company

Which means:


Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members,
Increased accountability in project leadership,
Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.


Who are we looking for?

¡En Ayesa Digital crecemos Contigo!




Cada profesional de nuestra empresa es importante para nosotros, nos ayudan a crecer de manera diversa y gracias a ellos somos más de 11.000 personas trabajando con el mismo objetivo en 10 países.

Si eres una persona entusiasta y buscas un nuevo reto profesional, ¡Este es tu sitio!

Buscamos ampliar nuestro equipo con un/a Data Analyst / Data Engineer especializado/a en SQL y BigQuery, con una sólida base en bases de datos relacionales y capacidad para comprender la lógica de negocio detrás del dato.




¿Qué harás?

Auditar y mapear tablas en Google BigQuery, identificando estructuras, dependencias y relaciones entre ellas.
Analizar modelos de datos complejos, incluyendo modelos estrella, copo de nieve y relaciones entre tablas.
Comprender el dato desde una perspectiva funcional y de negocio: qué significa cada campo, cómo se calculan las métricas y KPIs y qué particularidades pueden afectar a su interpretación.
Documentar estructuras, relaciones y reglas de negocio de forma clara y comprensible.
Diseñar el contexto semántico necesario para que los agentes de IA puedan interpretar correctamente la información disponible.
Crear y optimizar prompts e instrucciones para LLMs, ayudándoles a generar consultas SQL correctas sobre las bases de datos.
Definir mecanismos y contexto que permitan reducir errores y evitar alucinaciones de los modelos de IA al trabajar con datos.
Actuar como puente entre el conocimiento técnico del dato, la lógica de negocio y las capacidades de los agentes de Inteligencia Artificial.




¿Qué buscamos?




Experiencia demostrable como Data Analyst, Data Engineer, BI Analyst o en posiciones similares.
Experiencia trabajando intensivamente con bases de datos relacionales.
SQL avanzado, con capacidad para construir, analizar y optimizar consultas complejas.
Experiencia práctica con Google BigQuery.
Capacidad para analizar modelos de datos y comprender relaciones, dependencias y estructuras complejas.
Capacidad de abstracción para transformar conceptos técnicos y reglas de negocio en documentación estructurada y comprensible.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita y capacidad para explicar conceptos técnicos de forma sencilla.
Interés o experiencia en Inteligencia Artificial, LLMs, prompt engineering o agentes de IA.

ayudaremos a marcar tu itinerario de futuro anualmente participando en proyectos

vanguardistas con los mejores profesionales del sector.

conciliación entre la vida profesional y personal: Flexibilidad horaria, Smart Job y jornada

intensiva en verano.

Seguro médico, Ticket Restaurant, Guardería y Transporte.

Title: Customer Strategy Analyst - Santander Insurance
Description:
Country: Spain

IT STARTS HERE




Santander (www.santander.com) is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organization, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.




This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.




Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.




The Wealth Management & Insurance division covers three businesses in all Santander Group countries: Insurance, Asset Management and Private Banking. We work to provide the best solutions to our clients in these three businesses in the 10 countries where we are present.




THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE




Santander Insurance is looking for a Customer Strategy Analyst based out of Madrid.




The role will develop a deep understanding of key customer performance indicators to support value creation and strategic decision-making. Reporting to the Customer 360 & AI Director within the Customer Strategy & AI team.




As a customer strategy analyst your mission will be to build and maintain a robust and scalable analytical framework to monitor, understand and drive customer strategy performance across global and local markets. The role will support data-driven decision making by providing actionable insights on key customer KPIs, identifying performance drivers, and assessing the business impact of strategic initiatives.




We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:




1. Customer Analytics Framework

Develop and maintain a robust analytical environment to monitor customer performance across geographies, ensuring consistency between global and local views.
Define and standardize KPIs, metrics and analytical methodologies to ensure comparability and alignment across countries.
Design and enhance reporting tools and dashboards to provide clear visibility on customer performance.




2. KPI Monitoring & Performance Tracking

Track and analyze the evolution of key customer KPIs, including:
Customer lifetime Value
Net Promoter Score (NPS)
Customer churn
Customer base evolution
Product holding (e.g., insurance policies per customer)
Identify trends, deviations vs. targets and early warning signals.
Provide regular performance updates to key stakeholders and senior management.




3. Deep-Dive Analysis & Insights Generation

Conduct in-depth analyses to identify key drivers of performance, improvement levers and potential risks to achieving budget and strategic targets.
Segment customers and behaviors to uncover actionable insights.
Support hypothesis generation and validation using data.




4. Business Impact Assessment

Analyze and quantify the impact of strategic initiatives (e.g., commercial actions, retention strategies, cross-selling initiatives) on customer KPIs and business outcomes.
Develop frameworks to measure ROI and effectiveness of initiatives.
Support prioritization of initiatives based on data-driven insights.




5. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

Work closely with business, data and local teams to ensure alignment on definitions, analyses and insights.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear and actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Support decision-making processes at both global and local levels.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING




Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organization. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.




The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.







Professional Experience

At least 5 years of professional experience in the insurance industry, preferably in roles related to analytics and performance tracking.
Proven experience in data analysis, KPI monitoring and business performance management.
Experience working with large and complex datasets across multiple sources.
Artificial intelligence application on task and process automation, data analytics and innovation. (Preferred)




Education

Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.




Languages

Very high proficiency in English and Spanish are required.
Portuguese is desirable (Preferred)




Hard Skills

Proficiency in SQL and Excel for data extraction and analysis.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to build dashboards and reports.
Familiarity with data models, data structures and analytical frameworks is a plus. (Preferred)




Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
Ability to connect data analysis with business impact and decision-making.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex insights to non-technical stakeholders.







WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT




Your contribution matters, and it’s recognized. You can expect a fair, competitive reward package that reflects the impact you create and the value you deliver. But we know rewards go beyond numbers.

We’re enable our teams to go beyond through global opportunities and broad career paths.
Flexibility that works. Enjoy a hybrid working models—some days remote, some days onsite with your team—along with flexible hours.
Learning for life. Access hundreds of courses on our platforms, including exclusive access to our global learning space: Santander Open Academy (www.santanderopenacademy.com)

Title: Mid Product Data Analyst
Description:
Your mission


We're looking for a Mid Product Data Analyst to join our Players tribe. You will own the analytics for a product domain end-to-end: from governing the tracking that captures user behaviour, to running the analyses that shape what gets built next. You will partner closely with product managers, engineers, and designers to make sure every key decision is grounded in data, not intuition.


What you'll be doing



Design and implement event tracking to capture user interactions and behaviour within your product domain.


Govern tracking quality in your domain: validate that events are firing correctly, maintain the Gold Standard event set, and keep tracking debt under control.


Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor) to accelerate your analytical work; validate AI-assisted output for accuracy and business context before it influences decisions.


Analyze user funnel drop-offs to identify root causes of friction and lost conversions.


Evaluate A/B test results to assess the impact of product changes, and make sound recommendations even when results are inconclusive.


Build and maintain dashboards to track product performance and KPIs across your domain.


Work closely with data engineers and analytics engineers to co-create reliable data products and pipelines.


Run structured analyses across multiple data sources to surface trends and product opportunities.


Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and designers to embed data in every product decision.


Translate insights into clear, actionable recommendations for product improvement and feature development.



Our ideal player



Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or Computer Science, or related fields.


Minimum 2 years of experience in data analytics or a similar role, ideally with more than 1 year in product analytics.


Strong SQL knowledge and experience working with relational databases.


Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.


Understanding of experimentation (A/B Testing, Multivariate Testing).


Familiarity with event-based analytics tools like Mixpanel or Amplitude.


Basic understanding of machine learning and data engineering concepts.


Basic knowledge of programming languages like Python or R.


Good communication and presentation skills, and the ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.



Extra points



Experience using AI tools (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar) in a data or analytics workflow, including building prototypes.


Experience in a marketplace.


Cloud data warehouse experience (Google BigQuery, AWS Redshift, or similar).


Knowledge of dbt or other data pipeline tools.


Experience with predictive modeling (Forecasting, MMM, Neural Networks).


Based in Madrid or Barcelona, Spain.



Our hiring process



People Interview — First contact and cultural fit at Playtomic.


Technical Interview — With our Product Analytics Manager.


Stakeholders Interview — With a PM and Head of Data.


Final Cultural Interview — With our Product Lead.





About PLAYTOMIC




We are the world's largest racket sports App for players and clubs. Our goal is to socialize sports practice: through the app, players can book courts, find other players with similar skill levels, and join a social community dedicated to playing.




Since 2017, Playtomic has earned the trust of national and international investors, consolidating it as one of the main world players in sports digitalization. You will find +150 co-workers around the world with headquarters in Spain and offices in Madrid, Italy, Portugal, Sweden, Finland, Belgium, the UK, EEUU, and Mexico.

Title: Analista de Datos y Business Intelligence
Description:
Buscamos incorporar un/a Analista de Datos y Business Intelligence con al menos 3 años de experiencia en una posición similar para formar parte del Departamento de Business Operations.

La persona seleccionada será responsable de transformar datos procedentes de diferentes sistemas y áreas de la compañía en información fiable y útil para la toma de decisiones. Trabajará de forma transversal con los equipos de negocio, desarrollando soluciones de reporting, cuadros de mando e iniciativas de automatización y mejora de procesos.

Buscamos un perfil con una base técnica sólida, autonomía y capacidad para comprender las necesidades del negocio y convertirlas en soluciones de análisis claras, eficientes y escalables.

Principales responsabilidades

· Analizar, depurar, estructurar y consolidar datos procedentes de distintas fuentes y sistemas.

· Recoger y analizar los requerimientos de las distintas áreas, transformándolos en soluciones de análisis y reporting.

· Definir métricas e indicadores para el seguimiento de la actividad y los objetivos de negocio.

· Garantizar la calidad, coherencia, integridad y trazabilidad de la información.

· Identificar desviaciones, inconsistencias y oportunidades de mejora en los datos, procesos y sistemas de reporting.

· Documentar los modelos, indicadores y soluciones desarrolladas.

· Dar soporte a los usuarios y facilitar la correcta interpretación de los informes.

· Colaborar con equipos técnicos y áreas de negocio en proyectos transversales relacionados con datos, sistemas y procesos.

· Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener informes y cuadros de mando en Power BI.

· Crear modelos de datos, medidas y cálculos mediante Power Query y DAX.

· Realizar consultas, extracciones y transformaciones de datos con SQL.

· Automatizar tareas recurrentes, informes y flujos de trabajo mediante Power Automate.

· Trabajar con información procedente de sistemas ERP y CRM, como SAP S/4HANA, Microsoft Dynamics NAV y Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

Requisitos

· Experiencia profesional mínima de 3 años como Analista de Datos, Analista de Business Intelligence, BI Developer o en una posición similar.

· Experiencia demostrable en el desarrollo y mantenimiento de informes y cuadros de mando con Power BI.

· Conocimientos sólidos de modelado de datos, Power Query y DAX.

· Experiencia práctica con SQL y bases de datos relacionales.

· Nivel avanzado de Excel.

· Experiencia con datos procedentes de sistemas ERP y CRM.

· Capacidad para comprender las necesidades de negocio y transformarlas en indicadores, análisis y soluciones de reporting.

· Autonomía para gestionar proyectos de principio a fin y responsabilizarse de la calidad de los entregables.

· Nivel C1 de inglés.

· Titulación universitaria en Matemáticas, Estadística, Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería Industrial, Economía, ADE o disciplinas relacionadas.




Conocimientos valorables

· Experiencia en automatización de tareas y flujos de trabajo, especialmente con Power Automate.

· Experiencia trabajando con SAP S/4HANA, especialmente con el módulo MDG.

· Conocimiento de Microsoft Dynamics NAV y Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

· Conocimientos de gobierno, calidad y gestión del dato.

· Experiencia en documentación funcional y técnica de soluciones de Business Intelligence.

Competencias profesionales

· Capacidad analítica y orientación a la resolución de problemas.

· Visión de negocio y comprensión de procesos operativos.

· Rigor, atención al detalle y compromiso con la calidad del dato.

· Autonomía, organización y orientación a resultados.

· Iniciativa para identificar oportunidades y proponer mejoras.

· Capacidad para comunicar información compleja de forma clara.

· Facilidad para colaborar con perfiles técnicos y áreas de negocio.

Qué ofrecemos

La posición ofrece la oportunidad de ampliar la experiencia en análisis de datos y Business Intelligence, participando en proyectos transversales con impacto directo en el negocio. La persona que se incorpore podrá profundizar en tecnologías como Power BI, SQL, Power Automate, SAP y Microsoft Dynamics, asumir progresivamente proyectos de mayor alcance y contribuir a la evolución del modelo de reporting, la automatización y la gestión del dato de la compañía.

Además, tendrá contacto directo con diferentes áreas de negocio, lo que le permitirá desarrollar una visión global de la organización y reforzar tanto sus competencias técnicas como su capacidad para comprender procesos, proponer mejoras y convertir necesidades empresariales en soluciones basadas en datos.




¿Te interesa?

Si cuentas con experiencia en análisis de datos y Business Intelligence, dominas Power BI y SQL y te motiva convertir los datos en información fiable y accionable, nos gustaría conocerte.

Únete al equipo de Business Operations y participa en proyectos que contribuyen a mejorar los procesos, la calidad de la información y la toma de decisiones de la compañía.

Title: Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
Si para ti un dato no es solo un número en una celda, sino el inicio de una historia que puede cambiar el rumbo de un negocio, tenemos que hablar.

En WAM sabemos que tener la mejor infraestructura de datos no sirve de nada si nadie sabe interpretarla. Buscamos a un/a Marketing Data Analyst que sea la pieza clave que conecte el trabajo técnico con las decisiones estratégicas de nuestros clientes.

Bajo el liderazgo del Data Lead, y trabajando codo con codo con Data Engineering, serás la persona encargada de transformar datos complejos en insights accionables, cuadros de mando interactivos y conclusiones de negocio brillantes.

Tu misión será convertir la complejidad del dato en claridad estratégica. Diseñarás dashboards avanzados y modelos analíticos que aporten luz a los clientes, demostrando el ROI y apoyando el crecimiento transversal de nuestros estudios a través de la evidencia innegable del dato.

Lo que harás (de verdad):

Análisis 360º del Negocio:


Desarrollar modelos analíticos que permitan analizar el impacto de cada canal de marketing durante todo el ciclo de vida digital del cliente.
Estandarizar la estrategia de analítica y reporting unificando la metodología a nivel compañía y facilitando el discurso de las distintas áreas de marketing y ventas.
Realizar análisis tanto globales de negocio como por área (adquisición, conversión, retención o loyalty).
Ser capaz de integrar y analizar datos de canales offline y online para facilitar la toma de decisiones de negocio.


Visualización de Datos:


Diseñar, evolucionar y mantener cuadros de mando interactivos en herramientas líderes (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) que permitan identificar oportunidades de negocio, detectar tendencias y facilitar la toma de decisiones basada en datos.
Asegurar que la capa visual sea intuitiva, accionable y cuente la historia correcta.


Implementación Técnica


Ser capaz de definir junto con los equipos de estrategia la implementación necesaria para garantizar una correcta captación del dato para posteriormente convertirlo en reportes para el cliente.
Coordinar junto al equipo técnico la implementación técnica en las distintas plataformas del cliente (eCommerce, Web, App, etc).


Consultoría y Calidad:


Asesorar a dirección y equipos de Creatividad, Marketing y Ventas en la toma de decisiones basadas en datos para impulsar el crecimiento y eficiencia de nuestros clientes.
Apoyar al Data Lead en la interpretación de los datos para reuniones ejecutivas, traduciendo la complejidad técnica en recomendaciones estratégicas claras para el cliente.
Trabajarás de la mano con el Data Engineer para asegurar la calidad y veracidad absoluta de los datos.
Documentar la lógica de negocio y mantener el glosario de KPIs de cada proyecto.


Crecemos contigo, cuidamos de ti:


Horario flexible: Conciliación de tu vida personal y profesional.
Modelo híbrido: Nos gusta vernos 1-2 días a la semana en la oficina, pero siempre con máxima flexibilidad.
Salario: entre 34K - 40K € brutos anuales, dependiendo de tu experiencia.
Días especiales: Día libre en tu cumpleaños y el 24 y 31 de diciembre.

Retribución Flexible: Accede a nuestro plan con Cobee.

Title: Senior Data Analyst Growth
Description:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Meet the Team

The Marketing & Growth team is one of the largest and most dynamic at Fever, playing a central role in driving visibility, engagement, and business impact across the company. We work closely with nearly every department, combining strategy, creativity, and data to connect millions of people with unforgettable experiences.

Join us if you want to drive global impact, master data-driven creativity, and help millions of people discover their next unforgettable experience.

The Role

We're looking for a Growth Analytics Sr analyst to become the analytical backbone of Secret Media Network. You'll own the data infrastructure that the wider team relies on, and you'll use that data to actively find ways to grow the business. This is a hands-on role that mixes data engineering with genuine business analysis, and increasingly, AI-powered automation. You won't just report numbers, you'll help shape decisions with them and build the tools that make that analysis faster.

What You'll Do

Data Infrastructure & Reporting


Own and maintain the data pipelines and dashboards that power the team's reporting.
Ensure a single, consistent definition of core metrics across the team, so everyone measures success the same way.


Business Analytics & Experimentation


Design and run experiments to identify what drives better performance - from content formats to on-site features - and turn results into clear recommendations.
Proactively dig into the data to surface growth opportunities the team isn't yet acting on, not just answer questions you're asked.
Translate analysis into business impact


Data Foundations & Governance


Design the data and definitions that the whole team builds on. Not just fixing issues as they appear, but architecting the pipelines so those issues don't happen in the first place.
Set and enforce standards for data quality, documentation, and access, so the team can trust and self-serve the data with confidence.


AI & Automation


Use AI tools to speed up and scale analysis. From automating recurring reports to building AI-assisted workflows that surface insights without manual digging.
Identify opportunities to automate manual data/reporting processes, partnering with the team's automation and tooling function where needed.
Stay current on AI-powered analytics tooling and bring in what's genuinely useful


Cross-Functional Support


Act as the go-to data partner for the different functions across the team, translating their questions into reliable, fast answers.
Present findings in a way that non-technical stakeholders can act on, not just technical ones.


Who You Are


You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or another STEM field.
3-5 years of experience in a Data Analyst / Analytics / Business Intelligence role, ideally in a fast-paced, digital-first environment.
SQL skills and hands-on experience with modern data stacks (dbt or equivalent, cloud data warehouses).
Experience building and maintaining dashboards (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, or similar).
Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate or accelerate analytics work
A genuinely curious, business-minded analyst — someone who enjoys asking "why" and "what should we do about it," not just "what happened."
Experience designing or analyzing A/B tests / experiments is a strong plus.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning messy questions into clear analysis.
Proficiency in both written and spoken English is a must; Spanish is a plus.


Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

Title: Junior Business Information Analyst - Madrid
Description:
El analista de datos I interactúa con equipos globales y multifuncionales de toda la organización. Trabaja con el personal de auditoría de campo y otros analistas de datos para definir y completar proyectos de conversión de datos del cliente según los requisitos de la auditoría mediante el desempeño de las siguientes funciones.


Tasks


• Realiza tareas de análisis que utilizan conocimientos de negocios y contabilidad para dirigir o desarrollar la programación necesaria para proporcionar la auditoría requerida herramientas al sitio de auditoría.

• Convierte datos de clientes a formatos estándar PRGX aprovechando la programación SQL basada en parámetros.

• Garantice la integridad de los datos verificando la legibilidad de los datos, la estructura de los datos, el contenido de los datos, el alcance de los datos, etc., ayudando así a eliminar los problemas relacionados con los datos dentro del proceso de flujo de datos comerciales.

• Bajo supervisión general, responde a solicitudes del personal de auditoría para conversión de datos, informes estándar, informes no estándar y soporte relacionado. cuestiones que incluyen análisis y programación.

• Ayuda a otros miembros del equipo a evaluar, diagnosticar y corregir problemas de aplicaciones comerciales.

• Proporciona soporte de programación a otros miembros del personal sobre cuestiones de diseño de sistemas empresariales, aplicaciones personalizadas y cuestiones de programación, según sea necesario.

• Aumenta el conocimiento de las aplicaciones PRGX y amplía el conocimiento técnico a través de publicaciones comerciales, cursos y demostraciones.

• Amplía la comprensión de las prácticas, técnicas y auditorías comerciales de PRGX.

• Contribuye al éxito de la organización ayudando a otros a lograr resultados laborales; aprender nuevas habilidades necesarias para el equipo; mejorar la reutilización del código; encontrar nuevas formas de ayudar al equipo


Requirements


• Licenciatura (BA) de un colegio o universidad de cuatro años; o de uno a tres años de experiencia y/o capacitación relacionada; o combinación equivalente de educación y experiencia.

• Más de 1 año de experiencia en un entorno de oficina, análisis de datos y/o conversión relacionada.

• Experiencia en MS SQL y T­SQL; análisis de bases de datos relacionales

• Se valorará la exposición/conocimiento de formatos JSON y plataformas de almacenamiento de objetos.

• La exposición a varios formatos de archivos como delimitados, posicionales y EBCDIC es una ventaja

• Exposición/conocimiento de soluciones de informes como Power BI

• Conocimiento de scripting Python básico para automatizar tareas.

• Conocimientos de contabilidad o auditoría financiera; la exposición a los sistemas financieros (SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft, JD Edwards, etc.) es una ventaja

• Sólidas habilidades analíticas y de comunicación.

• Experiencia con productos MS Office.

• Capacidad para trabajar en un entorno de equipo dinámico y de alto rendimiento

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Meet the Team

Our Business Intelligence team turns information into insights that help move Fever forward. We uncover insights, deliver analysis and build technology that support teams across the company to make smarter and faster decisions.

Our main objective: bring clarity to complex data to drive business decisions. We focus on performance and investor insights, lead BI projects and data initiatives, and build impactful technology and dashboards. Join us if you are excited about turning raw data into strategic growth, lead high-impact BI projects, and build the insights that shape the future of our business.

Fever is looking for an Analyst that will play a vital role in taking our products to the next level, deepening/ widening our current understanding of our users and identifying improvement opportunities for our product. We're looking for someone with great analysis skills, the ability to get things done and a genuine interest in our customers.

This is the perfect position for someone who knows a variety of techniques and tools related to data analysis (examples of techniques: data warehousing, clustering, predictive models, pattern recognition, examples of tools: R, Google Analytics, MicroStrategy, etc), enjoys working in a team and loves digging into data to uncover product/business problems and opportunities. Auditing any changes to ensure data accuracy and normalization of data

Completing critical analysis that will drive growth and provide insight

Strong analytical and quantitative skills, strong bias towards data-based decision.
To love data - designing models, reporting, driving results/growth
Excellent written and spoken English.

High sense of ownership, urgency, and drive.

Formarás parte de equipos que dan soporte a procesos clave dentro del ecosistema financiero, participando en la gestión operativa, el análisis de información y la mejora continua de procesos.

Seguimiento, gestión y optimización de procesos en entornos de Global Transaction Banking (GTB).
Análisis y explotación de datos para la generación de información de gestión.
Automatización y mejora de procesos operativos mediante herramientas de análisis.
Elaboración de reportes y seguimiento de indicadores.
Coordinación con diferentes áreas de negocio tanto a nivel nacional como internacional.




¿Qué harás?

Analizar y mantener información financiera y de negocio.
Revisar documentación legal y comercial relacionada con productos de inversión.
Garantizar la calidad, integridad y actualización de los datos.
Investigar incidencias y validar información procedente de distintas fuentes.
Colaborar con equipos nacionales e internacionales.




¿Qué buscamos?

Entre 1,5 y 2 años de experiencia en análisis de datos, operaciones o funciones similares.
Nivel de inglés C1 o superior.
Conocimientos de SQL (valorable).
Interés por el sector financiero.
Nociones básicas de documentación legal, contratos o revisión documental.
Alta capacidad analítica y atención al detalle.
Capacidad para trabajar con grandes volúmenes de información.

Formar parte de un entorno de excelencia especializado en la gestión de operaciones financieras y proyectos corporativos, trabajando con profesionales de referencia y desarrollando una carrera dentro de áreas como Banca Transaccional, Mercados, Financiaciones, Riesgos y Operaciones.




Exposición a procesos internacionales y colaboración con diferentes equipos de negocio.
Formación continua y acompañamiento profesional.
Jornada completa.

N World está formado por tres compañías especializadas que ofrecen servicios end-to-end a clientes de mercados de capitales, banca mayorista, banca de inversión, seguros y Real Estate:

NFQ: Consultoría especializada.

Title: Associate Data Research Analyst (Korean Speaker)
Description:
About Morningstar

Morningstar is a leading global provider of independent investment insights, serving both individual and institutional investors across public and private markets. Our offerings include a wide range of data, research, and investment management services, with $300+ billion in assets under management. Operating in 32 countries, Morningstar supports financial advisors, asset managers, retirement plan providers, and more with comprehensive investment solutions.

The Role

Our EMEA Managed Investment Data Operations team is looking for an Associate Data Research Analyst to process our data across global markets. We are a team of data analysts who have effective relationships with other teams and are committed to deliver best quality data. As an Associate Data Research Analyst in the Data Division, you will work closely with the Global Data Team and Local Business Representatives, taking responsibility for data coverage, quality, and timeliness to the highest standards. The Operation Data Analyst will form closer links with providers related to data acquisition processes and gain knowledge of our database. The position will be based in our Data and Development Center EMEA in Madrid and will report to the Associate Data Manager.

Responsibilities


Actively collect & Process managed investment data using Morningstar collection systems, and ensure data timelines, completeness, and accuracy to meet business goals.
Collaborate closely with the global data teams.
Data expert on investment data points, processes, methodologies, calculations & different fund structures.
Manage business relationships with fund companies. Connecting with providers & setting up acquisition channels for complex and more advance data as well as acting as a point of escalation.
Meet the predetermined production deadlines for internal and external clients.
Continuously evaluate procedures, create and enhance analytical tools, and implement process improvement projects.
Utilize project management methodologies such as LEAN Six Sigma to track, evaluate and determine resolution approach for complex data issues.
Demonstrate a high sense of ownership of the issues in the data ticket queue to be responsive and provide timely updates, follow-up, expedition, and resolution.
Understand roles, responsibilities, and expertise of internal partners to expedite issue resolution.
Translate requests from internal clients into detailed written specifications and user stories.
Improve and document client use cases to ensure any new functionality meets and exceeds client expectations


Requirements


A bachelor’s degree or equivalent is required.
Proficient oral and written communication skills.
Fluency in English and Korean is mandatory
Collaborates well in a team environment, have the ability to communicate and work with team members from diverse backgrounds, in a conscientious and inclusive way.
Be client centric.
Solid understanding of the financial industry and passionate about investment data.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills, capable of handling high volumes of data and meeting strict deadlines.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and


Ready to Shape the Future? At Morningstar, every hire we make strengthens our mission to empower investor success. Apply now and help shape the future of investing with us.

Base Salary Compensation Range

EUR 29.000,00-39.000,00

Bonus Target

5% Annual

We expect the compensation and target bonus for this role to fall within the stated range. The specific compensation offered will depend on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and other job-related factors.

Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

Description:
Main Purpose

The main purpose of this role is to act as the primary link between business stakeholders and the Data & Analytics team, ensuring that reporting and analytics requirements are clearly defined, prioritized, and translated into high-quality BI solutions.

In a greenfield environment and during the transition from legacy reporting tools to Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, the BI Analyst will work closely with Finance, Operations, and other business functions to understand business processes, define KPIs, and support the delivery of consistent, trusted reporting. The role plays a key part in shaping the BI roadmap, managing the BI backlog, validating requirements, and supporting adoption, while ensuring alignment with data governance standards and the overall BI delivery model.

Key Responsibilities: Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Business Requirements & BI Analysis


Gather, analyse, and document BI and reporting requirements from business stakeholders.
Define and validate KPIs, metrics, and business rules in collaboration with Finance and operational teams.
Map existing legacy reports to future BI use cases and data models.


BI Delivery & Collaboration


Act as a core member of the BI Delivery squad, participating in sprint planning, refinement, demos and retrospectives.
Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
Own and manage the BI demand backlog, supporting prioritization in alignment with business value.


Reporting & Validation


Design and develop Power BI reports and dashboards, ensuring usability and business relevance.
Build and maintain semantic models, including measures (DAX), relationships, and data structures.
Perform functional testing and validation to ensure accuracy, usability, and business alignment.
Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) and support rollout and adoption.

Support data governance initiatives by documenting KPIs, definitions, and reporting standards.
Promote consistent use of certified datasets and semantic models.

Technical Skills

Ability to define and validate KPIs, metrics, and business rules.
Experience working with ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric or modern cloud data platforms.


Soft Skills


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to structure ambiguous requirements into clear, actionable deliverables.
Well-organized, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities.

Formando parte del área de Inversiones de la compañía, buscamos la incorporación de una persona que será responsable del desarrollo de herramientas de valoración de activos financieros y análisis de datos, así como la automatización en la generación de informes y el mantenimiento de las bases de datos asociadas.

Valoración de activos financieros a partir de herramientas implantadas o desarrollos ad-hoc según las características del activo.

Generación de información a partir de procesos automáticos, optimización de los informes ya existentes tanto los propios del departamento como los flujos de información con el resto de las áreas de la compañía.
Mantenimiento de las BBDD incrementando eficiencia, agilidad en el proceso de captura, modelado y explotación de la información.
Interacción con los equipos actuariales y con sus plataformas para realizar pruebas de estrés y sensibilidad
Generar reportes actuariales y financieros (Solvencia II, IFRS 17/IFRS 4, Embedded Value, Capital Económico), integrando resultados de la plataforma.

Experiencia deseada:




Experiencia profesional mínima de 3 años en puestos similares: aseguradoras, banca, consultoría, auditoría, Corporate Finance…
Capacidad de análisis de activos, entendimiento del negocio y valoración de operaciones.
Elevados conocimientos financieros, con experiencia en modelización financiera.
Capacidad de gestión de proyectos, planificando, gestionando y ejecutando operaciones de manera autónoma.
Experiencia en mantenimiento y explotación de bases de datos

Licenciatura/Grado en Economía, Administración de Empresas, Finanzas, Ingeniería o similares.
Valorable Master y/o certificados (CFA, CAIA o FRM).
Manejo experto de Excel, Access, SQL, Python y/o C#, Bloomberg. Dominio recomendable de otras herramientas (Clarity, Prophet, FiNCAD, PowerBi…).
Nivel alto de inglés. Se valorarán otros idiomas.




Habilidades:




Fuerte ética de trabajo y alto nivel de compromiso y responsabilidad.
Capacidad analítica y de organización, con orientación a resultados y pensamiento crítico.
Adaptabilidad y flexibilidad.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y capacidad de relación e interlocución muy elevada.

Title: Senior Consultant - Data Analytics & Corporate Real Estate
Description:
¿Te imaginas participando en la transformación de las principales organizaciones nacionales e internacionales?

En Deloitte estamos comprometidos con generar un impacto en la sociedad, en nuestros clientes y en ti.

Buscamos un/a Senior Consultant con fuerte enfoque en analítica de datos para incorporarse al equipo de Workplace Strategy en el área de Corporate Real Estate dentro de una firma líder global de servicios profesionales.

Este rol combina capacidades analíticas avanzadas con un enfoque consultivo, siendo responsable de transformar datos complejos en insights estratégicos que apoyen la toma de decisiones en ámbitos como optimización de espacios de trabajo, modelos de trabajo híbrido y transformación del workplace, uso de los espacios,etc.

Trabajarás en proyectos nacionales para el portfolio de las oficinas de Deloitte a nivel nacional colaborando con equipos multidisciplinares e interactuando con el negocio.

¿Cómo es el reto?


Liderar el análisis de datos de ocupación, utilización de espacios y comportamiento de empleados para identificar palancas de eficiencia y mejora.
Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones de reporting y dashboards ejecutivos (principalmente en Microsoft Power BI), adaptados a distintos niveles de la organización.
Traducir necesidades del área en modelos analíticos y KPIs accionables (occupancy, utilization, demand vs capacity, scenario modelling, stacking plan, Workplace métrica)
Integrar y estructurar datos procedentes de múltiples fuentes (IWMS/CAFM, HR systems, sensores, wifi, herramientas de booking).
Participar activamente en proyectos de consultoría, aportando insights basados en datos en iniciativas de workplace Strategy, Space calculator, Optimización de portfolios inmobiliarios, movimientos de personal y propuesta de stacking plan, etc.
Interactuar con áreas de negocio presentando datos y resultados.
Contribuir al desarrollo de capacidades analíticas internas (metodologías, modelos, automatización de reporting).
Trabajar con equipos de tecnología, HR, FM y Finanzas para alinear iniciativas de Workplace.
Impulsar una cultura data-driven dentro del área de Corporate Real Estate
Introducir soluciones de IA en el día a día del área de Workplace para optimizar procesos.


¿Cómo te imaginamos?


Grado en Ingeniería, informática, ADE, Arquitectura, Data Analytics o similar.
3–6 años de experiencia en analítica de datos, BI o consultoría (idealmente vinculada a real estate, workplace o transformación organizativa).
Experiencia avanzada con Microsoft Power BI (modelado de datos, storytelling).
Sólidos conocimientos de Excel y capacidad de estructuración y análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos.
Experiencia trabajando con múltiples fuentes de datos y procesos de ETL.
Familiaridad con conceptos de workplace Strategy y real estate
Nivel de inglés alto (C1)
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, síntesis y presentación a cliente.
