Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
About Qualifyze:




Founded in 2019, Qualifyze is a leading company in supply chain compliance management in the Life Sciences industry, trusted by over 1,500 pharmaceutical and healthcare companies globally. Our digital suite of solutions connects manufacturers, suppliers, and a global network of more than 250 auditors and quality experts.




With a track record of over 4,500 audits across 85+ countries and the largest and most accurate supplier network and data analytics tools, Qualifyze stands as the all-in-one partner for quality compliance and supply chain risk mitigation in the Life Sciences sector.




Role Overview:




As an Analytics Engineer, you will be at the forefront of scaling our analytics capabilities through robust data modeling, metric consistency, and AI-powered workflows. Your goal is to bridge the gap between raw data and business insight, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs, translating them into reliable data structures, and ensuring that the metrics powering our decisions and Investor Reporting are accurate, consistent, and trustworthy.

You combine a deep understanding of business logic with the technical capability to build and maintain scalable internal data models and semantic layers.




Main responsibilities:




The team member shall perform the present tasks inherent to such position, including, but not limited to, the following:

Map, document, and evaluate current data models, metrics, and reporting flows. Critically evaluate existing definitions and assumptions, identify inconsistencies, and propose improvements that enable scalability and self-service analytics.
Build and maintain metrics for Investor Reporting using dbt metrics, ensuring they are accurate, well-documented, and aligned with agreed business definitions.
Support the modeling and maintenance of Marts and the last-mile Gold layer, contributing to a robust and scalable semantic layer that serves both operational and analytical use cases.
Ensure consistency between metrics in Investor Reporting and in Looker, performing regular cross-checks and validations to guarantee a single source of truth.
Perform data sanity checks from a business logic perspective to validate new data structures before they reach production, catching issues early and reducing downstream errors.
Conduct ad-hoc analyses to support decision-making, unblock stakeholders, and surface actionable insights when needed.
Help define and document business definitions, KPIs, and data processes to ensure a shared understanding across business and technical teams.
Participating in projects involving agentic technologies applied to BI, including multi-agent implementations built with Claude and similar frameworks, innovate and expand what agentic analytics can deliver.




Main requirements:




Strong SQL skills and solid Python proficiency for data transformation, validation, and analytics workflows.
Proven experience building and maintaining dbt models and metrics, including Marts and Gold/last-mile layers.
Solid understanding of semantic layer concepts and BI consistency practices, ideally with hands-on experience in Looker or similar tools.
A strong business logic mindset, able to understand what a metric means, not just how it is calculated, and to spot when something doesn't add up.
Interest in or experience with agentic AI systems, including LLM-powered workflows and multi-agent architectures applied to analytics.
Excellent collaboration and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technical teams.
A proactive, detail-oriented mindset with a passion for data quality, consistency, and continuous improvement.




What do we offer?




💰Competitive, annually reviewed compensation package
🌴Country vacation package that increases with your tenure
🏋🏽 Country specific benefits offering incl. private health care, fitness and meal allowances
🚀Annual personal development budget to increase your impact
🌎Hybrid working mode, plus up to 3 months of the year work from anywhere.
💻All the best kit and tools to work effectively
🎉Annual in person all company event and celebration in Europe
👫Working with an exceptional team, doing some of the best work of your career




At Qualifyze we actively support the power of diversity, uniting complementary talents and perspectives to address new challenges. Our collective strengths help us to find innovative solutions and turn difficulties into opportunities. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone belongs and feels heard.




We are an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, disability, or age. Our hiring practices are rooted in fairness and respect, and we strive to create a culture where everyone feels valued and empowered.

Join one of Europe's leading airlines and help shape safer operations through data




At Morgan Philips Outsourcing, we are partnering with one of Europe's leading airlines, based in Barcelona, to recruit a Safety Data Analyst.




This is a unique opportunity for a data-driven professional who wants to apply their analytical expertise to a high-impact environment where every insight contributes to operational excellence, crew wellbeing and aviation safety.




You will play a key role in analysing operational data, identifying trends and risks, and supporting strategic decisions related to human performance and fatigue management across flight operations.




Why this role?

✈ Make a direct impact on airline safety and operational performance.

📊 Work with large datasets, predictive models and business intelligence tools.

🧠 Solve complex challenges at the intersection of data, human behaviour and operations.

🌍 Join an international and highly collaborative environment.

Develop reports, dashboards and actionable insights for management.

Deliver awareness and training initiatives on fatigue risk management.
Participate in innovative projects involving biometric and operational performance data.

Background

Degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Data Analytics, Aviation Management or a related discipline.
Additional training in Human Factors, Safety Management Systems or Risk Management will be considered a plus.




Experience

Minimum 4 years of experience in analytical, operational, safety, risk management or data-focused roles.
Experience working with large datasets and translating information into business recommendations.
Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau and/or Python is highly valued.
Aviation experience is a plus but not required.




Skills

Fluent English and Spanish.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to identify patterns, trends and operational risks from complex data.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Highly organised, detail-oriented and proactive.

Title: BI Analyst – Revenue Operations
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online. 📱💻

Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países. 🌍

Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos a alguien que se haga cargo de: consolidar el reporting comercial en dashboards gobernados (Tableau/Superset), dar acceso fiable al data warehouse a los equipos que lo necesiten, y sacar del Excel manual todo lo que hoy se sostiene a base de fórmulas y copia-pega.

Es un rol de ownership local de BI: construirás y mantendrás la infraestructura de datos que sales/cs opp —y el resto de la organización comercial— usan para trabajar.

What You'll Do


Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y modelos de datos en Tableau/Superset para Sales, Customer Success y áreas comerciales
Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones
Dar y administrar acceso al data warehouse para los equipos que lo requieran, garantizando calidad y consistencia del dato
Traducir necesidades analíticas de Sales Ops, CS y Marketing en especificaciones técnicas y dashboards accionables
Detectar y corregir problemas de calidad de dato en la fuente, no solo en el reporte final
Documentar modelos de datos y procesos de BI para que sean sostenibles sin depender de una sola persona


Requisitos


2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados
Nivel de ingles alto o bilingüe.


Nice-to-have:


Conocimiento de Python para automatización de pipelines o limpieza de datos
Dominio y experiencia con CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) y su estructura de datos
Conocimiento y experiencia en modelos de negocios y GTM modelo SaaS, funnel de ventas etc.


Eres la persona que buscamos si...


Eres una persona proactiva y con mentalidad de ownership: no esperas a que te digan qué construir, identificas dónde falta gobierno de dato y lo propones.
Estás cómod@ operando con ambigüedad: el rol y las herramientas van a seguir evolucionando mientras el equipo global centraliza más tooling
Eres alguien entrepreneurial: te motiva construir algo desde una base poco estructurada, no solo mantener un sistema ya hecho

Summary



ABOUT US



We are an international pharmaceutical company committed to the veterinary profession, with a constantly growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products and diets. Our focus is on veterinarians, whom we approach with compelling solutions designed to make us their trusted partner.

Dechra is one of the fastest-growing and most consistently successful global veterinary companies. Our size enables us to maintain a personal approach, remain flexible and respond quickly to change, allowing us to make decisions with agility.

At the same time, we are a strong and well-established company, with the product portfolio and technical capabilities needed to provide our customers with the support they need.

OUR PEOPLE

Are solution oriented and pro-active
Love working together
Have a 'can do' mentality
Are easy to approach
Value honesty
Are professional
Are able to punch above their weight
Have the desire to win
Have fun

YOU WILL FIT IN

If you have strong analytic and problem-solving skills
If you are able to understand the business and deliver based on a strong commercial focus
If you are self-motivated and highly organized
If you are responsive and flexible to change
If you are cooperative and have the desire to make a difference together
If you are structured and independent

TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

This is a key role at Dechra in Iberia as the company is growing fast and data analysis is gaining importance to support business decisions and improvements.

The Data Analyst is ultimately responsible for making available and clear all data necessary to contribute to translate the strategy and plans into clear reports by using relevant data. The tasks and responsabilities include:

Analysis of sell in and sell out data across all the business areas.
Management of the source master data (customer and product) ensuring the reliability and veracity of data.
Validating development requests from the business allowingreports improvement and upgrades.
Management of the CRM data and reports (maintenance and update).
Preparation of periodic and ad hoc reports to analyse comercial stategies.
Collection and consolidation of data from different sources (mainly Excel and SQL Server).
Process documentation.
Involvement in budgeting and forecasting process.
Evaluation and process of the data to facilitate the decision taking from sales, marketing and business managers.
Develop strong internal relationship with the sales team to understand the market and support them.
Ensure the connection between CRM and marketing.
Providing user support services to ensure problems are remediated quickly and effectively.
Providing training (Targit, Salesforce, BI software) for new users and new functionality for existing users.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE

This job might be for you when you have:

A higher education or degree within the area of Computer science, Economics, Finance, or related bachelor degree.
Experience of Business Intelligence systems.
Ideally a minimum of 2/3 years' experience in a similar position.
Basic programming skills for data manipulation.
Ability to develop key and beneficial relationships with stakeholders.
Excellent commercial networking approach to enable the growth of the business.
Ability to structure and organize effectively and deliver to tight deadlines.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, written and verbal.
Natural leadership skills to lead high performing teams.
High level of Excel use.
Knowlegde of SQL/Power BI/Targit/ Salesforce.
Ideally based in Barcelona.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Spanish Fluent (verbal and written)

English Fluent English

Title: Operations Data Analyst - Specialist
Description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

Job Ref ID: JR0082142

Your Work-life Opportunity

Join our team and become an integral part of Glovo's Global Logistics! We provide a dynamic and challenging environment filled with numerous opportunities for growth and development.

In this role, you will be responsible for redesigning, testing, and implementing the payment structures that motivate and reward our riders worldwide. By blending deep data analysis and data modeling with creative problem-solving, your work will ensure our logistics network is efficient, scalable, and fair for our riders. The KPIs you will influence are crucial to operations, as every decision made will directly affect the whole operational investment (biggest company cost).

Be a Part Of a Team Where You Will


Explore and find the most optimal logistics payment structure in order to maximize global riders engagement.
Strategically redesign our courier payment framework to improve key operational metrics, designing models that reward factors like vehicle used, distance, weight, and peak-hour availability.
Dive deep into massive datasets to identify trends, drivers, and opportunities. Your insights will be the foundation for optimizing our entire operational investment.
Own the experimentation process to validate your ideas. You will design, run, and analyze experiments (A/B testing, switchback tests) to precisely measure the impact of payment structure changes before a global rollout.
Continuously monitor the performance of your strategies. You will track KPIs, assess the effectiveness of your changes, and make data-driven adjustments as needed.
Understand and address local and regional needs by stepping into the shoes of the riders and truly understanding their perspective.


Qualifications

YOU HAVE


Degree in Engineering, Maths or another STEM field.
2+ years of experience in a data analytics role where you translated insights into tangible business actions and measured their impact.
Strong technical proficiency
Advanced SQL for complex querying and data extraction.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis and data orchestration.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or PowerBI.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. You are comfortable breaking down ambiguous, complex problems into manageable steps and driving towards a clear solution.
Nice to have experience with experimentation. Designing and/or analyzing A/B tests or other statistical testing methodologies to measure impact.
Comfortable working in a high-growth and high-performance environment, dealing with ambiguity while maintaining a positive mindset.
You can clearly and concisely explain complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Fluent English is a must.
You are organized, take ownership of your work, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Additional Information

Individuals representing diverse profiles, and abilities, encompassing various genders, ethnicities, and backgrounds, are less likely to apply for this role if they do not possess solid experience in 100% of these areas. Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

We Believe Driven Talent Deserves


💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.
🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings!
💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses.
🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.
🏖️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year!
👪 Enhanced parental leave, and office-based nursery.
🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being.


At Glovo, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.

Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. You are comfortable breaking down ambiguous, complex problems into manageable steps and driving towards a clear solution.

Comfortable working in a high-growth and high-performance environment, dealing with ambiguity while maintaining a positive mindset.

You are organized, take ownership of your work, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Description:
Description

Are you passionate about data? Does the prospect of dealing with massive volumes of data excite you? Do you want to create the next-generation tools for intuitive data access for transportation operations?

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer to help setup and deliver robust, structured reporting, analytics and models, automations and AI initiatives for the Volume Planning teams in Europe. You will be a key contributor to shaping our strategic innovation program by equipping the project teams with the insights into the operation performance.

You will have an eye for detail, proficient/advanced SQL/DW/Python and have a knack for solving challenging data, reporting and automation challenges. The role requires you to feel comfortable working with and clearly communicating with other functional teams, regionally and globally.

The position will be based in Barcelona. You will be reporting to a Business Intelligence Manager, working intensely with his (larger) project team. The ideal candidate will be comfortable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment; will be a creative and an analytical problem solver with the opportunity to fulfill the Amazon motto to “Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History”.

Key job responsibilities


Develop analytical solutions to business problems that utilize the highest standards of analytical rigor and data integrity
Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation
Write high quality code to retrieve and analyze data
Analyze and solve business problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context
Design pragmatic analyses and automated metrics that add value to your business area
Understand data resources and how, when, and what to use (and what not to use).
Develop analyses (whether fully formed or exploratory) for the business’ sake, not for analyses’ sake
Seek to understand the business objectives relevant to your area, and align your work to those objectives and seek to deliver business value
Proactively and continually, improve your level of knowledge about Amazon’s business and relevant data resources


A day in the life


Analysis of business requirements and translation into technical requirements. By support of senior colleagues integration into a working, stable and scalable system
Independent realization of requirements for Business Intelligence and custom software development products
Creation of test cases and guidance of business stakeholders within the testing process
Presentation of solutions and implemented features within weekly sync up with business stakeholders
Ownership of maintenance and error handling of deployed solutions
1 – 2 main projects in parallel
Focus on project delivery


About The Team

As part of EU Supply Chain Execution's Data and Analytics team, we support Volume Planning team across all miles (First Mile (Fulfilment Centers), Middle Mile (Sort Center, Linehaul), Last Mile (Delivery Stations) and End to End alignement) teams.

We Support a Wide Variety Of Products Ranging From


Forecasting models and tools
Automations
Traditionnal BI reporting (mainly QuickSight)


A highlight of our team is our meme based Sprint Retrospective to have a fun time looking back on what we delivered.

Basic Qualifications


Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
Experience with SQL
Experience in the data/BI space


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
As one of our Games Data Scientists you will be the business facing masterminds who help turn business questions into actionable insights. You research and analyze player behaviour, and come up with recommendations. Data Scientists do this by listening to team members, understanding context and challenging business ideas. Data Scientists use diverse techniques - frequentist and Bayesian statistics, machine learning, exploratory and explanatory data analysis, causal inference, data visualization, monte carlo modelling, econometric analysis, etc. Such broad requirements call for the ability to learn quickly, work efficiently with peers and communicate data clearly and effectively. Games Data Scientists are true visionaries who support business decisions with data and in-depth analytics.

You will have the opportunity to work with large and complex data sets, with the autonomy to make a huge impact on the success of our games. You will also be working as part of an experienced and highly skilled team of 20 with opportunities to learn and develop.

What You'll Do
Discuss with stakeholders requirements for analysis
Run exploratory data analysis and turn it into questions which can be answered with analytical techniques
Use simple analytics, statistical or causal inference, machine learning or any other techniques to answer questions and address problems
Communicate results clearly and effectively
Take care of unclear and ambiguous requirements
Communicate complex ideas and analyses in a simple way
Work independently on complex projects
Be willing to acquire new skills and learn new methodologies, whether related to stakeholder management, communication or data science
Be able to use diverse data science tools and approaches


What We're Looking For
A degree or equivalent work experience in data driven field
Ability to use visualization techniques for communicating data and analysis
Experience of using any of the following to answer business or scientific questions -statistics, mathematics, machine learning, econometrics, causal techniques, monte carlo modelling, etc.
R/Python experience
Knowledge and experience of SQL

Title: Data Analyst - MicroStrategy
Description:
Somos Cívica

Corría el año 2008. El WhatsApp no existía, los datos vivían en Excel y las nubes estaban solo en el cielo.

La idea era sencilla de explicar, pero ambiciosa de ejecutar: crear un espacio donde las personas pudiesen colaborar, una consultora tecnológica donde los datos y el desarrollo se unieran para impulsar soluciones a medida, siempre con el trato cercano de toda la vida.

Hoy seguimos fieles a esa esencia: combinamos el poder de los datos y la ingeniería de software para ayudar a empresas a tomar mejores decisiones, innovar y crecer… sin perder nunca el factor humano que nos hizo nacer. Y sí, lo hacemos para grandes compañías, con presencia nacional e internacional, que confían en nosotros para proyectos de alto impacto.

Así empezamos, y así seguimos: con tecnología, sí, pero con alma. Porque, para nosotros, la innovación no va solo de código y servidores, sino de poner la tecnología al servicio de las personas. Aquí nadie es un número de ticket ni un “usuario final”: somos personas trabajando con otras personas, con nombres, ideas y muchas ganas de aportar.

La colaboración es nuestro sistema operativo. Porque sabemos que, cuando combinamos talento, compromiso y un poco de sentido del humor, el resultado no es solo un buen producto: es una forma de trabajar que genera impacto real, refuerza comunidades y mejora vidas.

Esto es Cívica: tecnología con propósito, personas que se implican y un equipo que cree que colaborar es mucho más que compartir documentos en la nube. Y si algo tenemos claro, es que el talento es el corazón de todo lo que hacemos. No solo el de quienes se sientan en nuestras oficinas, sino también el de quienes confían en nosotros como clientes y partners. Cuidar, desarrollar y retener ese talento no es una tarea más: es nuestra ventaja competitiva, y por eso hacemos realidad nuestro lema People Beyond Tech, recordando cada día que la tecnología avanza rápido, pero las personas son las que marcan la diferencia.

¿Quieres saber qué hacemos?

En Cívica, usamos la tecnología como una palanca para mejorar realidades.

Acompañamos a Grandes Organizaciones En Su Viaje Hacia La Transformación Digital, Alineando Datos, Diseño y Desarrollo Con Impacto Tangible En El Negocio. Así Es Como Lo Hacemos


Data Analytics: Transformamos datos en decisiones. Creamos informes, dashboards y portales que convierten información cruda en inteligencia estratégica.
Data Engineering: Diseñamos y gestionamos arquitecturas que aseguran flujos de datos fiables, continuos y escalables.
Data Quality & Governance: Creamos ecosistemas de confianza. Establecemos controles y políticas para garantizar que los datos siempre digan la verdad.
Artificial Intelligence: Damos inteligencia al futuro. Modelos predictivos y sistemas automatizados que optimizan procesos y multiplican el valor.
Front & Back Development: Construimos soluciones robustas. Desde aplicaciones web hasta APIs, traducimos necesidades de negocio en tecnología útil y escalable.
Design: Diseñamos experiencias claras. Combinamos funcionalidad y estética para conectar con las personas desde la primera interacción
Business & Management: Hacemos que la tecnología hable el idioma del negocio. Alineamos soluciones con los objetivos específicos de sectores como banca o seguros, asegurando resultados desde el día uno.


¿Por qué enamorarte de nosotros?

Porque no todas las empresas tienen tan claro el papel que quieren jugar en el mundo como lo tenemos en Cívica. Para nosotros, no se trata solo de lo que hacemos, sino de por qué y cómo lo hacemos. No nacimos para seguir tendencias tecnológicas, sino para construir soluciones con propósito, con rigor técnico, transparencia y transformaciones reales para las organizaciones que las utilizan.

El epicentro de nuestro trabajo no está solo en los resultados, sino en el enfoque. Cada proyecto nace de una escucha atenta, una necesidad real y una convicción compartida: la tecnología debe ser comprensible, escalable y transformadora. Desde la ingeniería hasta el análisis, desde el gobierno del dato hasta el diseño, todo lo que hacemos sigue una lógica colaborativa y humana.

Diseñamos plataformas que mejoran servicios, desarrollamos sistemas para tomar decisiones de negocio y acompañamos a organizaciones que entienden que los datos no son solo activos, sino herramientas de cambio. Trabajamos con instituciones, empresas y administraciones públicas que buscan tecnología comprensible, escalable y que genere valor. Lo hacemos con herramientas punteras —Snowflake, dbt, Google Cloud, entre otras—, pero, sobre todo, con una forma de pensar crítica, abierta y honesta.

Hemos crecido paso a paso, consolidando un equipo interdisciplinario que combina pensamiento crítico, excelencia y una visión ética sobre el uso de la tecnología. Nuestra trayectoria no se mide solo en líneas de código, pipelines y dashboards actualizados, sino en vínculos de confianza, valor aportado y transformaciones reales.

En Cívica no se trata de hacer más, sino de hacer mejor. Por eso, para quienes buscan un entorno donde la tecnología se construye con criterio, conciencia y confianza, este es un lugar al que es fácil querer sumarse.

¿Qué buscamos?

Sabemos que esta oferta no es para todo el mundo (ni lo pretendemos).

Buscamos a quienes no se conforman con el “esto siempre se ha hecho así”.

Aquí venimos a mover cosas. A veces demasiado. A veces nos equivocamos. No somos perfectos, pero lo que sí tenemos son ganas. De hacer cosas que molen, que importen, que dejen huella. Y de crecer.

De currar con gente con criterio, con energía positiva, con ganas de dar opinión y de trabajar en equipo. Y sí, también de disfrutar. Porque, como dice nuestro CEO, Josep: “Aunque estemos trabajando, no hace falta estar todo el día con un palo en el c…”.

Bueno, mejor esta parte te la contará cuando os conozcáis.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades en este rol?

Esta no es una oferta puntual ni para cubrir un proyecto concreto.

Buscamos un compañero de viaje que quiera crecer con nosotros y sumar al largo plazo en el equipo de Cívica.

🔗 Desarrollo de la capa semántica

📑 Diseño y construcción de dossier e informes

🧭 Desarrollo y apoyo en el autoservicio guiado

🎓 Formación de usuarios

Que la comunidad te acompañe...

Dale al play y descúbrelo....⏯️

¿Qué necesitamos por tu parte?

Estos Son Nuestros ☝🏻 NO Negociables


3-4 años de experiencia profesional con MicroStrategy : experiencia real en desarrollo y capa semántica
Conocimiento de Strategy y últimas versiones.
Proactividad y autonomía sobre el modelo y los distintos objetos de la plataforma.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación.
Orientación a la formación y acompañamiento de usuarios finales.


¿Cómo será nuestro proceso de selección?

📞 Primera llamada — ¡Hola, hola!

Si tu perfil nos hace ojitos, te llamaremos para una charla breve y romper el hielo. Queremos conocerte un poco y contarte por qué creemos que podrías encajar con nosotros.

💬 Videollamada con Talento — Nos ponemos cara

Si seguimos conectando, agendamos una videollamada para hablar de tú a tú. Te contaremos más sobre Cívica, cómo trabajamos y cómo vivimos nuestra cultura de equipo... Y, por supuesto, también queremos escucharte.

💻 Charla techie — Hora de hablar en tu idioma

Si hay match, llega el momento de sumergirnos en lo que más te gusta: herramientas, tecnologías, proyectos, retos... Una charla con nuestro equipo técnico para evaluar tu nivel.

😏 ¿Ya está? ¿Así de fácil?

Pues sí. Ni gymkanas imposibles ni entrevistas eternas. Queremos que el proceso sea tan fluido como tomarte un café con alguien que te cae bien (aunque sea por videollamada).

¿Qué ocurrirá en tu primera semana?

Tu incorporación empieza en nuestra oficina de Granada, pero lo más importante no será el lugar: será cómo te vas a sentir.

Somos Cívica

Corría el año 2008. El WhatsApp no existía, los datos vivían en Excel y las nubes estaban solo en el cielo.

La idea era sencilla de explicar, pero ambiciosa de ejecutar: crear un espacio donde las personas pudiesen colaborar, una consultora tecnológica donde los datos y el desarrollo se unieran para impulsar soluciones a medida, siempre con el trato cercano de toda la vida.

Hoy seguimos fieles a esa esencia: combinamos el poder de los datos y la ingeniería de software para ayudar a empresas a tomar mejores decisiones, innovar y crecer… sin perder nunca el factor humano que nos hizo nacer. Y sí, lo hacemos para grandes compañías, con presencia nacional e internacional, que confían en nosotros para proyectos de alto impacto.

Así empezamos, y así seguimos: con tecnología, sí, pero con alma. Porque, para nosotros, la innovación no va solo de código y servidores, sino de poner la tecnología al servicio de las personas. Aquí nadie es un número de ticket ni un “usuario final”: somos personas trabajando con otras personas, con nombres, ideas y muchas ganas de aportar.

La colaboración es nuestro sistema operativo. Porque sabemos que, cuando combinamos talento, compromiso y un poco de sentido del humor, el resultado no es solo un buen producto: es una forma de trabajar que genera impacto real, refuerza comunidades y mejora vidas.

Esto es Cívica: tecnología con propósito, personas que se implican y un equipo que cree que colaborar es mucho más que compartir documentos en la nube. Y si algo tenemos claro, es que el talento es el corazón de todo lo que hacemos. No solo el de quienes se sientan en nuestras oficinas, sino también el de quienes confían en nosotros como clientes y partners. Cuidar, desarrollar y retener ese talento no es una tarea más: es nuestra ventaja competitiva, y por eso hacemos realidad nuestro lema People Beyond Tech, recordando cada día que la tecnología avanza rápido, pero las personas son las que marcan la diferencia.

¿Quieres saber qué hacemos?

En Cívica, usamos la tecnología como una palanca para mejorar realidades.

Acompañamos a Grandes Organizaciones En Su Viaje Hacia La Transformación Digital, Alineando Datos, Diseño y Desarrollo Con Impacto Tangible En El Negocio. Así Es Como Lo Hacemos

  • Data Analytics: Transformamos datos en decisiones. Creamos informes, dashboards y portales que convierten información cruda en inteligencia estratégica.

  • Data Quality & Governance: Creamos ecosistemas de confianza. Establecemos controles y políticas para garantizar que los datos siempre digan la verdad.
  • Artificial Intelligence: Damos inteligencia al futuro. Modelos predictivos y sistemas automatizados que optimizan procesos y multiplican el valor.
  • Front & Back Development: Construimos soluciones robustas. Desde aplicaciones web hasta APIs, traducimos necesidades de negocio en tecnología útil y escalable.
  • Design: Diseñamos experiencias claras. Combinamos funcionalidad y estética para conectar con las personas desde la primera interacción
  • Business & Management: Hacemos que la tecnología hable el idioma del negocio. Alineamos soluciones con los objetivos específicos de sectores como banca o seguros, asegurando resultados desde el día uno.

¿Por qué enamorarte de nosotros?

Porque no todas las empresas tienen tan claro el papel que quieren jugar en el mundo como lo tenemos en Cívica. Para nosotros, no se trata solo de lo que hacemos, sino de por qué y cómo lo hacemos. No nacimos para seguir tendencias tecnológicas, sino para construir soluciones con propósito, con rigor técnico, transparencia y transformaciones reales para las organizaciones que las utilizan.

El epicentro de nuestro trabajo no está solo en los resultados, sino en el enfoque. Cada proyecto nace de una escucha atenta, una necesidad real y una convicción compartida: la tecnología debe ser comprensible, escalable y transformadora. Desde la ingeniería hasta el análisis, desde el gobierno del dato hasta el diseño, todo lo que hacemos sigue una lógica colaborativa y humana.

Diseñamos plataformas que mejoran servicios, desarrollamos sistemas para tomar decisiones de negocio y acompañamos a organizaciones que entienden que los datos no son solo activos, sino herramientas de cambio. Trabajamos con instituciones, empresas y administraciones públicas que buscan tecnología comprensible, escalable y que genere valor. Lo hacemos con herramientas punteras —Snowflake, dbt, Google Cloud, entre otras—, pero, sobre todo, con una forma de pensar crítica, abierta y honesta.

Hemos crecido paso a paso, consolidando un equipo interdisciplinario que combina pensamiento crítico, excelencia y una visión ética sobre el uso de la tecnología. Nuestra trayectoria no se mide solo en líneas de código, pipelines y dashboards actualizados, sino en vínculos de confianza, valor aportado y transformaciones reales.

En Cívica no se trata de hacer más, sino de hacer mejor. Por eso, para quienes buscan un entorno donde la tecnología se construye con criterio, conciencia y confianza, este es un lugar al que es fácil querer sumarse.

Sabemos que esta oferta no es para todo el mundo (ni lo pretendemos).

Aquí venimos a mover cosas. A veces demasiado. A veces nos equivocamos. No somos perfectos, pero lo que sí tenemos son ganas. De hacer cosas que molen, que importen, que dejen huella. Y de crecer.

De currar con gente con criterio, con energía positiva, con ganas de dar opinión y de trabajar en equipo. Y sí, también de disfrutar. Porque, como dice nuestro CEO, Josep: “Aunque estemos trabajando, no hace falta estar todo el día con un palo en el c…”.

HTML:
Data analisten…Wij maken graag tijd voor jullie vrij. Voor diverse organisaties zoeken wij met regelmaat de beste data analisten die er zijn. Dit betreffen zowel vaste functies als interim opdrachten.

Ben jij als data analist op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging en herken je jezelf in onderstaand profiel? Wij komen graag in contact met jou!

data analist

  • Het definiëren en meten van de KPI’s t.b.v. websites, campagnes en andere online initiatieven;
  • Het waarborgen van de inrichting van het webanalyse pakket;
  • Het opzetten en uitvoeren van analyses van online marketing acties en dit vertalen naar actionable data;
  • Het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van dashboards en standaard rapportages, op basis van de behoeften van de verschillende afdelingen;
  • Het verzorgen van analyses en rapportages bij ad-hoc acties;
  • Pijnpunten opsporen in de verschillende customer journeys t.b.v. conversieoptimalisatie;
  • In overleg met de conversieoptimalisatie expert analyseren van online gebruikers onderzoeken, MVT en A/B testing;
  • Het correct meten bij de implementatie van nieuwe functionaliteiten en/of nieuwe websites;
  • Het testen van nieuwe versies van de websites op het gebied van webanalyse;
  • Samenwerking met de afdeling online marketing en marketing intelligence voor optimalisering van campagnes en product propositie.

wie ben jij?

Als data analist beschik je over een afgeronde HBO/WO opleiding en heb je minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring op het gebied van data analyse, bij voorkeur in een grote E-Commerce omgeving.

Je bent een zelfstarter, analytisch sterk, oplossingsgericht, proactief en vernieuwend. Ervaring met de inrichting van een webanalysepakket (bij voorkeur Omniture) is gewenst. Andere sleutelwoorden zijn: gemotiveerd, enthousiast, verantwoordelijkheid en communicatief.

Wij zijn altijd opzoek naar digitaal talent. Drop hier je CV, wij helpen je graag naar de volgende stap!

Title: Data Analyst II - Treasury
Description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Data Analyst - Treasury

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Reporting team and we are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Treasury domain!

Our data mission is to develop and maintain Ebury’s Data Platform and serve it to the whole company. This platform is the backbone of Ebury: it supports internal decision making, allows us to monitor our Treasury positions and risks, comply with regulatory reporting obligations and enables commercial opportunities globally.

The Data team works closely with Treasury, Product and Tech teams to coordinate and implement data analysis initiatives helping the Cash management, ALM and Treasury Reporting teams. Some of the projects we are currently working on include: MtM valuations reconciliation with our Treasury reporting system to ensure completeness and accuracy in our Financial statements, cash operational charges data analysis to reduce Treasury costs, liquidity data analysis to help ALM team manage daily liquidity obligations, and building AI agentic workflows to automate routine data operations and decision support, and many many more!

As part of the team you will


Work closely with the rest of the Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Engineering, Treasury and Product teams
Be responsible for modelling data in our collaborative data platform to perform critical Treasury data analysis and build reports and reconciliations for the Treasury domain
Manage end-to-end treasury solutions across all jurisdictions of the company from requirements gathering, building optimised data models and delivering the reports to our treasury stakeholders and auditors
Maintain and build dashboards and visualisations on the data platform using our BI tools for Treasury teams to monitor reporting and controls


What we’re looking for


2+ years of experience in Data/Business Analytics - applied to Treasury or Finance is a plus!
Advanced SQL skills - must be able to read and write complex SQL queries
Experience with our modern data stack tools (a plus!) We use dbt, Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, DataStudio), Sigma
Strong problem solving and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail

Description:
¡En Neural buscamos un/a Analista de Datos! 🌟

¿Quiénes somos? 🏢

Nuestra misión es clara: mejorar la calidad de vida de las personas a través de la neurorrehabilitación, el acompañamiento en salud mental y la atención a la infancia con trastornos del neurodesarrollo.

¿Qué buscamos? 🔍

Para seguir creciendo, necesitamos incorporar a una persona que comparta nuestra visión, buscamos un Analista de Datos que transforme datos operativos y de negocio en información accionable. Trabajará junto a equipos de tecnología y negocio para diseñar métricas, construir cuadros de mando y dar soporte a la toma de decisiones.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones? 📝


Recopilar, depurar y modelar datos procedentes de múltiples fuentes y plataformas.
Diseñar y mantener cuadros de mando e informes (Power BI / equivalente) para las unidades de negocio.
Analizar tendencias, incidencias y patrones de uso para anticipar problemas de forma proactiva.
Definir y calcular KPIs de servicio (SLA, capacidad, utilización) y de negocio.
Automatizar consultas y procesos repetitivos de reporting mediante SQL y scripting.
Documentar especificaciones de datos y garantizar la calidad e integridad de la información.
Colaborar con Business Analysts, arquitectos y equipos de proyecto para alinear objetivos y entregables.


¿Qué ofrecemos? 📃


Contrato indefinido

Plan de carrera, formación y desarrollo profesional
Salario a convenir

Nuestras oficinas centrales se encuentran en Valencia (Polígono Vara de Quart).

Grado profesional/universitario con 4-6 años de experiencia en analítica de datos o roles equivalentes.
Dominio de SQL y de al menos una herramienta de visualización (Power BI, Tableau o similar).
Experiencia en modelado de datos, ETL y tratamiento de grandes volúmenes de información.
Conocimiento de estadística descriptiva y capacidad de análisis de tendencias.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación para traducir datos en recomendaciones de negocio.

Python o R para análisis avanzado y automatización.
Experiencia con plataformas cloud (AWS, Azure o GCP) y servicios de datos gestionados.
Conocimiento de gobierno del dato y buenas prácticas de seguridad de la información.

Description:
Position Summary

At Camper, we walk to a different beat, and our data strategy is no exception. We are looking for a BI Engineer to help us build, evolve, and scale our enterprise Data Warehouse. You will play a key role in connecting raw data with strategic decision-making, designing robust data models, and creating intuitive dashboards that empower teams across the company to make data-informed decisions.

Responsibilities.


Data Architecture & Modeling: Design, build, and maintain scalable data models within our Data Warehouse to power analytics and Data Governance.
Pipeline Integration: Extract, transform, and load (ELT/ETL) data from diverse source systems (ERP, E-commerce, Marketing platforms), ensuring high data quality and reliability.
Dashboarding & Visualization: Create functional, high-impact dashboards and reports using tools like Looker, Looker Studio, or Power BI to serve both business users and leadership.
Self-Service & Enablement: Foster a data-driven culture by enabling non-technical stakeholders to perform self-service analytics and conducting ad-hoc deep dives when complex business questions arise.


Requierements.


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related fields.
Advanced SQL skills.
Prior experience with BigQuery.
Advanced knowledge of visualization tools (Looker, Looker Studio, Power BI).
English level B2.

Knowledge of Python or R.
Knowledge of DataFlow, DBT, Cloud Functions.
Advanced analytics techniques (inferential statistics)

A dynamic and multicultural working environment that fosters teamwork, learning, and professional growth.
Discounts on Camper products.
Team outings and events.
Immediate start date with a flexible schedule.

Title: Analista de Datos y BI (Inteligencia del Cliente)
Place: Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain
Description:
¿Te apasionan los datos y te motiva convertir la información en conocimiento que ayude a tomar mejores decisiones?

Si quieres seguir creciendo profesionalmente en el ámbito de Business Intelligence, reporting y modelos de datos, y te interesa formar parte de un proyecto con impacto directo en Marketing y Experiencia de Cliente, esta oportunidad es para ti.




Desde el área de Marketing y Experiencia de Cliente buscamos incorporar un/a Analista de Datos BI que nos ayude a construir y hacer evolucionar la inteligencia de cliente del grupo.

Buscamos una persona con capacidad analítica, orientación al dato y experiencia en BI y reporting, que quiera asumir un papel clave en la construcción, mantenimiento y evolución de nuestros cuadros de mando, modelos de datos y soluciones de reporting.

Tu trabajo será fundamental para conseguir que las áreas de Marketing dispongan de una información fiable, accesible y de calidad, convirtiendo los datos en una herramienta real para entender mejor a nuestros clientes y tomar decisiones con mayor impacto.




¿Cuál será tu misión?

Tu misión será construir, mantener y evolucionar el ecosistema de reporting, cuadros de mando y modelos de datos de cliente del grupo, asegurando que la información que utilizan las áreas de Marketing sea siempre disponible, consistente, fiable y de calidad.

Formarás parte del nuevo área de Inteligencia de Cliente, contribuyendo a crear la infraestructura de datos y el reporting recurrente que servirán de base para que el equipo de Customer Insights y las distintas áreas de Marketing puedan profundizar en el análisis, identificar oportunidades y dar respuesta a nuevas necesidades de negocio.




Una oportunidad para hacer crecer la inteligencia de cliente del grupo, aportar valor desde el dato y participar en la evolución de una nueva área con un papel estratégico para Marketing.




✨ ¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

Transformarás datos en información útil para el Negocio, diseñando modelos de datos, informes y cuadros de mando de cliente que permitan a las áreas de negocio, Marketing y Experiencia de Cliente tomar decisiones de forma ágil y basada en datos.
Impulsarás el autoservicio y la explotación del dato, evolucionando los modelos de información de cliente y facilitando su consumo a través de herramientas de reporting y visualización.
Construirás y mantendrás los procesos de datos, desarrollando y optimizando los ETL que alimentan el DWH del grupo y garantizando que la información esté disponible y preparada para su análisis.
Convertirás las necesidades del negocio en soluciones de datos, entendiendo los requerimientos de usuarios de negocio, Marketing y Experiencia de Cliente y dando respuesta a sus necesidades de reporting y analítica operativa.
Acompañarás a los usuarios en el uso del dato, ofreciendo soporte y ayudándoles a interpretar y sacar el máximo partido de la información disponible.
Velarás por la calidad y disponibilidad de la información, monitorizando los procesos y detectando y resolviendo posibles incidencias en la actualización o consulta de los datos.
Trabajarás en equipo para llevar el análisis un paso más allá, colaborando con Customer Insights y Data Science y proporcionando la base de datos y reporting necesaria para análisis ad-hoc y modelos avanzados.
Contribuirás a una cultura de dato segura y responsable, aplicando rigurosamente las medidas de seguridad y buenas prácticas asociadas a la gestión y explotación de la información







✨ ¿Qué te ofrecemos en el Grupo DISA?




Contrato indefinido
Incorporación estimada Septiembre-Octubre/26
Centro de trabajo: Tenerife, Gran Canaria ó Madrid
Formar parte de una Compañía sólida, en crecimiento y con proyectos transformadores.
Un entorno donde podrás aportar, proponer y desarrollar nuevas iniciativas.
Participación en proyectos estratégicos de impacto real en las personas y en el negocio.
Oportunidades de aprendizaje y crecimiento profesional.







Imprescindible

-Experiencia en puestos similares

-Residencia en Tenerife/Gran Canaria/Madrid




Valoramos

-Grado en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Estadística, Física, Ingeniería Industrial o similar

-Conocimientos en estadística, algoritmos, análisis de datos y tecnologías relacionadas, como bases de datos, almacenamiento de datos y extracción e integración de datos.

-Conocimiento de lenguajes propios del BI y Big Data, como Python, PySpark o lenguaje M (Power Query).

-Experiencia con herramientas de visualización como Power BI, Qlik, Tableau o similares

-Conocimientos en ecosistemas, plataformas y metodologías como Azure, Databricks, DevOps, GIT y Power Platform, principalmente Power Automate y Power Apps.

-Nivel de inglés alto

-Conocimientos en materia de protección de datos (RGPD).




Si quieres que tus conocimientos en datos se conviertan en decisiones que generan impacto, este es tu momento. Súmate al reto de construir la inteligencia de cliente del grupo y haz que cada dato cuente.




Las personas que concurran a nuestros Procesos de Selección y Evaluación serán valoradas en base a los requisitos del puesto de trabajo con objetividad, transparencia y respetando el principio de igualdad de oportunidades entre mujeres y hombres.

✅Se solicitará durante el proceso de selección la documentación necesaria que certifique los datos informados en el currículum

Title: Data Analyst (SQL, Python & Power BI)
Description:
¡En Ayesa Digital crecemos contigo!




En Ayesa Digital no esperamos al futuro, lo lideramos. A través de la tecnología y la ingeniería lo hacemos posible, convirtiendo retos en oportunidades, conceptos en soluciones y visión en impacto real. Paso a paso nos acercamos a un futuro mejor. Con tu pasión, talento y determinación, seguiremos transformando el presente y construyendo el futuro. Ayesa Digital, Making It Happen.




Si eres una persona entusiasta y buscas un nuevo reto profesional, ¡Este es tu sitio!




¿Te gustaría contribuir a proyectos que ayudan a comprender cómo se gestionan e implementan las inversiones públicas financiadas por la Unión Europea?




Buscamos un/a Data Analyst con experiencia en análisis, integración y gestión de datos para incorporarse a un proyecto internacional de alto impacto orientado a la generación de conocimiento basado en datos.

La persona seleccionada participará en iniciativas enfocadas en el análisis de grandes volúmenes de información procedente de múltiples fuentes, contribuyendo a la construcción de soluciones analíticas, modelos de datos y procesos de validación que permitan obtener información fiable para la toma de decisiones.

Trabajarás en un entorno multidisciplinar y colaborativo, combinando capacidades analíticas, gestión del dato y visualización para transformar información compleja en conocimiento accionable.




Qué harás

Recopilar, integrar y gestionar datos procedentes de diferentes fuentes estructuradas y semiestructuradas.
Diseñar y desarrollar procesos de extracción, transformación, limpieza y validación de datos utilizando SQL, Python, R u otras herramientas equivalentes.
Construir, mantener y optimizar bases de datos relacionales y analíticas.
Aplicar técnicas de normalización, reconciliación, deduplicación e identificación de entidades sobre conjuntos de datos heterogéneos.
Definir e implementar controles de calidad del dato, validaciones y procedimientos de trazabilidad.
Preparar flujos de trabajo reproducibles para el tratamiento y análisis de información.
Realizar análisis exploratorios, descriptivos y comparativos, desarrollando indicadores y métricas de negocio.
Crear dashboards, visualizaciones e informes para diferentes tipos de usuarios.
Participar en la validación de datos procedentes de procesos automatizados y herramientas basadas en Inteligencia Artificial.
Documentar metodologías, procesos, reglas de transformación y modelos de datos.
Colaborar con perfiles funcionales, técnicos y de negocio para garantizar la calidad y utilidad de los entregables.




Qué buscamos

Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería, Informática, Matemáticas, Estadística, Ciencia de Datos o disciplinas afines.
Experiencia en análisis, transformación y explotación de datos mediante SQL y Python, R o tecnologías equivalentes.
Experiencia en diseño y mantenimiento de bases de datos relacionales y analíticas.
Conocimiento de procesos de calidad del dato, metadatos, diccionarios de datos y trazabilidad de la información.
Experiencia en integración de datos procedentes de múltiples fuentes.
Conocimientos de técnicas de matching de entidades, reconciliación y deduplicación de registros.
Experiencia en desarrollo de visualizaciones y cuadros de mando con Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Qlik o herramientas similares.
Familiaridad con Machine Learning, NLP o herramientas de análisis asistido por IA.
Nivel alto de inglés (mínimo B2).
Capacidad para comunicar resultados analíticos a audiencias técnicas y no técnicas.
Capacidad de organización, trabajo en equipo y orientación a resultados.




¿Dónde trabajarás?




Sevilla - Híbrido - Oficinas del cliente




Te ofrecemos un camino lleno de aventuras:




Proyectos de gran prestigio en instituciones europeas.
Entornos internacionales, innovadores y multiculturales.

Title: Developer & Data Analyst
Description:
Con más de 50 años de trayectoria y un equipo de más de 500 profesionales comprometidos, el Grupo CHG / Oliva Nova es un referente empresarial que integra compañías líderes en los sectores inmobiliario, turístico, de restauración y de eventos deportivos en un entorno privilegiado entre Denia y Gandía. Desde 1972, el grupo se enfoca en desarrollar un proyecto en constante crecimiento que combina excelencia residencial, servicios turísticos de primer nivel y una amplia oferta de ocio y deporte.




Para reforzar nuestro equipo de IT, buscamos un/a Developer & Data Analyst con perfil técnico, analítico y orientado a la mejora continua de nuestros procesos y sistemas de datos.




MISIÓN DEL PUESTO

Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener las soluciones de datos e integración del Grupo, garantizando la calidad, disponibilidad y explotación eficiente de la información para la toma de decisiones del negocio.




RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES




Mantener y evolucionar los desarrollos existentes sobre el ERP corporativo, resolviendo incidencias y dando soporte al equipo de IT.
Integrar el ERP con sistemas verticales y aplicaciones de terceros mediante Web Services y APIs.

* Diseñar y mantener pipelines de datos (ETL/ELT) con SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) para la consolidación e integración de información entre plataformas.

* Desarrollar dashboards interactivos y cuadros de mando ejecutivos en Power BI para distintas áreas del negocio.

* Automatizar procesos de reporting mediante T-SQL avanzado y procedimientos almacenados.

* Mantener actualizada la documentación técnica de arquitecturas, flujos y soluciones implementadas.




REQUISITOS DEL PUESTO

Formación:




* Grado o Ingeniería en Informática, Ingeniería de Software, Sistemas de Información o similar.




Conocimientos sólidos en:




Desarrollo en C# / .NET con Visual Studio.
T-SQL avanzado: consultas complejas, procedimientos almacenados y optimización de rendimiento.

* SQL Server: Integration Services (SSIS / paquetes DTSX) y Reporting Services (SSRS).

* Power BI: modelado de datos, DAX, publicación y administración de workspaces.

* Azure Database Services.

* Integración de sistemas mediante Web Services / REST APIs.




Valorable experiencia o conocimientos en:




Certificación o experiencia en SAP S/4HANA.
Otras bases de datos relacionales o NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).

* Azure Data Factory u otros servicios cloud de datos.




Experiencia mínima:




* Preferiblemente entre 2 y 4 años en un puesto similar.




OFRECEMOS




Contrato indefinido a jornada completa.
Incorporación a un grupo empresarial sólido y en crecimiento.

* Oportunidades de formación continua en nuevas tecnologías.

Title: Senior Web Data Analyst (all genders)
Description:
BESTSECRET is the leading European online destination for premium and luxury off-price fashion. The Group offers its members in 28 countries across Europe a superior brand portfolio complemented by a high-end shopping experience. At the same time, BESTSECRET enables its brand partners to clear overstock at scale with minimum visibility and maximum brand equity protection. The unique business model is based on its closed character with an invitation-only customer membership, longstanding brand partner and customer relationships, combined with a tech-focused mindset. BESTSECRET has a strong track record of profitable growth over many years. It generated revenues of EUR 1,533.7 million in 2025 and employs around 2,200 people from over 90 nations. The Group draws on a heritage of 100 years in the textile and fashion industry and today is owned by Permira Funds and the founding families Schustermann and Borenstein.

Join our growing tech hub in Málaga and become part of an international team driving data-informed decision-making across BESTSECRET. As a Senior Web Data Analyst, you will be a core member of the Onsite Analytics team, working alongside the Director and 3 Senior peers to deliver critical insights that shape our business strategy. You'll own complex data projects from conception to delivery, translating raw data into actionable intelligence that empowers stakeholders across buying, product, and commercial teams.

In this role, you'll bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic business impact, ensuring that our premium fashion platform leverages data as a competitive advantage. Your work will directly influence purchasing decisions, optimize member experiences, and support the scaling of our profitable growth model.

Your Responsibilities


Design, build, and optimize data models and pipelines using SQL and Python to support analytics workflows at scale.
Develop and maintain Business Intelligence visualizations and dashboards that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Plan and execute A/B testing frameworks to validate hypotheses and measure impact across product and commercial initiatives.
Coordinate analytics projects with cross-functional stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear insights for non-technical audiences.
Manage Big Data workflows and ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across our platform.
Take ownership of analytical challenges, demonstrating initiative in problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Contribute to team culture through knowledge sharing, code reviews, and mentoring of junior team members.


Your Qualifications


3–5 years of professional experience with SQL and Python in a data analytics or data engineering role.
Proven expertise in data modelling and the ability to design scalable data structures.
Strong hands-on experience with Business Intelligence tools and creating impactful visualizations.
Demonstrated proficiency with A/B testing, including experimental design and statistical validation.
Experience with Git version control and collaborative development practices.
Solid background with Big Data workflows and distributed data processing.
Excellent project coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to non-technical partners.
Self-directed learner with a proactive, critical mindset and strong agile working mentality.
Fluent English skills (written and spoken).
Experience with data orchestration tools (Cron, Apache Airflow) is a plus.
Knowledge of dbt or similar data transformation frameworks is a plus.
Familiarity with tools like Power BI, Growthbook, Jira, or Confluence is a plus.
Background in statistics or quantitative research is a strong plus.
Experience implementing AI agents or modern AI tools in analytical workflows is a plus.


Our Benefits


Employee discount on our platform
Access to a corporate benefits platform with discounts on travel, hotels, electronics, and more
Private healthcare (tax-free), with the option to include your family
30 days of paid vacation per year plus local bank holidays
Hybrid work model (1–2 days per week in the office in Málaga)
Flexible working hours with core collaboration time (10:00 – 16:00)
Tailored development opportunities, including “TechFriday” – a monthly day dedicated to learning and innovation
Reduced working hours in August (summer schedule)
Choice of equipment: MacBook or Windows laptop
;


At BESTSECRET, diversity isn't just a trend – it's our professional philosophy. We are dedicated to cultivating an inclusive workplace where everyone's unique talents and backgrounds are celebrated. Applicants from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are welcome to join us in our mission towards a more vibrant and inclusive future.

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Data Analyst in the Checkout team, you will be in charge of:


Build the infrastructure required for the extraction, transformation and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources.
Assemble large and complex datasets, with an optimal data pipeline architecture, meeting business requirements.
Implement processes to monitor data quality, ensuring production data is always accurate and available for key stakeholders and business processes that depend on it.
Create alerts and dashboards to contribute to the monitoring and tracking of our business KPIs.
Identify, design and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimising queries, re-designing infrastructure for greater scalability, etc.
Collaborate with analytics and business teams to improve data models that feed existing reports or create brand new reports with the aim to increase data accessibility and foster data-driven decision making across the organisation.
Contribute to the delivery of strategic projects by participating in the delivery of key initiatives, giving support to the analytics and business teams when it comes to data availability and visualisation to ensure progress and effective delivery of the desired outcomes. Work together with stakeholders in the execution of the projects.

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, etc.).
Experience building and optimising data pipelines, data sets and workflow management tools (e.g. Dataform).
Advance knowledge of SQL is a requirement as well as experience working with databases and large sets of data; Python programming skills are also required as well as experience in data visualisation or exploration tools such as Looker Studio.
An AI-first mindset — proactively exploring how AI tools can improve efficiency and quality of work.
Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with Microsoft and Google Office packages (Excel, etc.).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail.
Strong organisational and communication skills.
Experience supporting and working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.
A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys having fun!
Business Proficiency in English.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.

The best talent deserves the benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.

Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.

  • Implement processes to monitor data quality, ensuring production data is always accurate and available for key stakeholders and business processes that depend on it.

Good to have

MTS Globe is one of Europe’s leading destination management companies, operating in 66 destinations across 23 countries and serving over 11.5 million travellers each year.

We connect travel brands, tour operators, and hotels, delivering high-quality destination services through local expertise, strong partnerships, and advanced technology. We provide a full range of destination services - from hotel accommodation and transfers to excursions, guided tours and cruise handling.

What do we offer?

At MTS Globe, you’ll be part of an international environment where people collaborate across cultures and borders. We offer a dynamic workplace where talent can grow, learn, and build a global career.

Why join us?

Join an international and multicultural team where you can grow your career, develop globally, and be part of a company that is constantly evolving in a dynamic industry.

JOIN US AND DISCOVER YOUR FUTURE WITH MTS GLOBE GROUP!

We are looking for an enthusiastic individual who wants to grow inside the business intelligence area.

Benefit from special health insurance rates.

We provide access to E-learning platform with courses about a wide range of data engineering tools, subsidized official Microsoft certifications and attendance to training events.

Degree in, Business Administration, Information Technologies, or related careers.
Previous experience in financial or accounting roles.
High level of English, spoken and written.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
Good communication skills and comfortable doing presentations.
Customer care oriented and keen on finding solutions to other people’s problems.
Availability to travel (occasionally).


Valued:


Experience in the Tourism industry.
High level of Spanish, spoken and written.
Knowledge of Microsoft Power BI.
Knowledge of T-SQL.
Knowledge of Azure Data tools.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Coches.net, Motos.net and Milanuncios.com are among the leading online marketplaces in Spain, connecting millions of buyers and sellers every month. We're looking for an exceptional Data Analyst to help us understand that audience at scale spotting the trends, opportunities and friction points that shape how we improve our products and services.

You'll work as part of a multidisciplinary team, collaborating closely with Product Owners, cluster teams, data engineers and stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Product, BizDev and Operations. You'll have real autonomy to define your own analyses, propose new lines of investigation, and see your insights turned into decisions that reach millions of users.

What you'll do


Identify, analyse and interpret KPIs and health metrics related to our users and customers, building dashboards and visualisations to monitor them.
Spot trends, risks and opportunities, and turn them into concrete recommendations to improve the different initiatives across the vertical.
Generate high-impact insights using advanced analytics to deepen our understanding of users and customers.
Actively contribute to the discovery and development of advanced analytical models — such as clustering and predictive models — and their implementation in real business use cases, including customer segmentation and propensity models for upselling, downselling and churn prediction.
Work day-to-day with a modern data stack (including tools like Databricks and Airflow), with room to grow your skills in data engineering and big data as the role evolves.


What we're looking for


3+ years of experience in eCommerce or an online company.
Solid knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Working knowledge of Python and/or R for data analysis (e.g. pandas, numpy, matplotlib) and analytics (e.g. scikit-learn).
Experience with at least one visualisation tool such as Tableau and/or QlikSense.
Strong analytical skills: comfortable interpreting data, extracting relevant insights, and translating business questions into analytical needs.


Nice to have


Experience working with sales, operations and strategy teams.
Knowledge of basic machine learning algorithms (e.g. clustering, classification, regressions).
Some experience with big data technologies (e.g. Databricks, data lakes).
Some knowledge of data engineering tools (e.g. Airflow, DBT).

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We help to redefine lending practices, uncover and prevent fraud, simplify healthcare, create marketing solutions, and gain deeper insights into the automotive market, all using our unique combination of data, analytics and software. We also assist millions of people to realize their financial goals and help them save time and money.

We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more industry segments.

We invest in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. As a FTSE 100 Index company listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN), we have a team of 22,500 people across 32 countries. Our corporate headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland. Learn more at experianplc.com.

Job Description

You will be part of a very dynamic and fast-growing Analytics team at Experian Spain, and you will develop analytical solutions to the benefit of our clients and their customers. You will collect and analyze large datasets to uncover insights and create solutions that support organizational goals, in the field of credit life cycle, risk management, fraud modelling or marketing. Technical, analytical, and communication skills are needed to interpret data and influence decision-making.

Main Responsibilities


Data Processing: Implementing processes to clean, transform, and organize raw data for analysis
Optimization: Enhancing data delivery and automating manual processes to improve efficiency
Data Analysis: Analyzing large volumes of structured and unstructured data to identify trends and patterns
Data Visualization: Creating visual reports to clarify business pain points.
Big data platforms: Using data/analytical platforms like Databricks, Cloudera, ...
Statistical Techniques: Using statistical techniques to validate findings and ensure accuracy
Machine Learning: Developing machine learning models and predictive algorithms to solve business problems
Programming Skills: Applying programming languages and domain-specific tools for analysis
Communication: Communicate with client and/or other departments/divisions within Experian to help ensure accurate and timely implementation of project work
Solving problems: Identify potential problems in the end to end process and take ownership for the resolution


Qualifications


2–3 years of experience in statistical or analytical project work, and/or experience in the financial services, telecommunications, retail, technology, or consulting sectors.
Degree or equivalent in a related field such as computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, or information technology, physics.
Highly PC literate with thorough knowledge of statistical:
Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis, advanced analytics and automation: Python with Pandas, Numpy and Machine Learning Packages and IT packages. PySpark, TensorFlow or PyTorch is an a plus
Knowledge of R, SQL, and SQL Server is highly valued as an additional asset
Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Cloudera, and Snowflake)
knowledge of Power BI for creating interactive dashboards
Understanding of statistical techniques which may be used to address client business issues
An innovative and inquisitive mind, focused on addressing and solving data and analysis problems
Fluency in written and spoken English


Good to have


Knowledge or hands-on experience with Generative AI concepts, including LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, and information retrieval.


Benefits/Perks


Great compensation package and bonus plan
Core benefits including Private Health Care and Experian wellness program
Flexible schedule, hybrid model of teleworking
Flexible time off including volunteer time off, personal leaves and paid holidays


Additional Information

Proud to be a Worlds Best Workplace 2025

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, collaboration, wellness, reward & recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's people first approach is award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2024 (Fortune Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, and Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2024 to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.

Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Innovation is an important part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, colour, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
