Title: Senior Data Business Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI
Description:
Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

Natixis in Portugal is currently seeking a Senior Data Business Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI to join its BPCE SI (BPCE Solutions Informatiques) team, within the IT (Information Technologies) department, to work in a hybrid work model in the Porto office, to join a data team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business requirements and our Data teams (Data Engineers, Data Analysts). To succeed in this mission, you will not just gather requirements: you will actively dive into the data by writing queries and analyzing our Oracle database tables to understand their structure, quality, and underlying logic.

Key Responsibilities


Write SQL queries to directly query and analyze tables within our database.
Explore and profile raw data to understand its structure, underlying business rules, and to identify potential anomalies.
Work closely with Data teams (Data Engineers, BI, and Analytics) to translate functional business rules into technical requirements.
Draft clear functional and technical specifications (source-to-target data mapping).
Assist business stakeholders in defining their requirements by providing a realistic view of the data actually available in the Oracle systems.
Design and execute test plans (both functional and technical data reconciliation).


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL (Essential): Strong ability to write complex queries (JOINs, subqueries, analytical functions, etc.) to query databases.
5+ years of solid experience as business analyst.
Oracle Environment: Proven experience working with Oracle databases (using tools such as PL/SQL Developer, TOAD, DBeaver, or SQL Developer).
Data Analysis: Ability to analyze data models (tables, views, primary/foreign keys).
Data Modeling: Basic understanding of data architecture concepts (Data Warehouse, Data Marts).
French: Minimum C1 level (fluent/advanced) is required, as you will interact closely with French-speaking business stakeholders and write functional specifications in French. A good level of English is also required.


We will only consider CVs in English.

Additional Information

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are committed to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

Title: Graduate Programme 2027: Data Scientist and Analyst
Description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Graduate Programme

Our Graduate Programme is built for ambitious graduates who want to launch their careers in fintech. Over this 12-month programme, you’ll work on real projects, solve complex challenges, and make an impact from day one. With structured training and hands-on experience, you’ll grow your skills while exploring different areas of the business.

Top performers can be promoted during or after the programme, giving you the chance to continue your journey at Revolut.

About The Role

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Scientists and Analysts work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We’re looking for Graduate Data Scientists and Analysts who are analytical, curious, and ready to deliver impact with data.

You’ll begin with an immersive boot camp designed to give you hands-on experience across the full data lifecycle. After that, you'll join a dedicated product team to specialise in your preferred data domain.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

Join us from anywhere

The Graduate Programme is open to international applicants willing to relocate to one of our tech hubs in Poland, Portugal, Spain, the UK, or the UAE. We’ll support you with visa assistance, travel costs, and accommodation (conditions apply). You’ll be expected to spend around 3 days per week in the office (where role and location allow).

Key dates


Applications: open from May 2026
Recruitment process: July–December 2026
Programme start: early 2027 (January–June) or late 2027 (July–December)


Roles are filled on a rolling basis, so apply early. You can specify your preferred intake during the recruitment process.

What You'll Be Doing


Taking part in a hands-on bootcamp and working on real projects across multiple teams
Helping to build analytical tools and machine learning models (such as dashboards and ETLs) to support product launches
Improving visibility in user sign-up flows and operational funnels
Enhancing and maintaining data infrastructure (including ETLs and LookML) to keep data accessible and reliable
Collaborating with teams across Operations, Growth, and Product to refine features and uncover insights

Title: Operational Risk Analyst - Data and Reporting
Description:
COFCO International is a global agri-business with a clear vision, strong values and a positive culture, focused on being a leader in the global grains, oilseeds and sugar supply chains. We provide the food the world needs in a responsible way. Headquartered is Geneva, Switzerland, we are ambitious, with the right structures and culture to meet the world's increasing and changing needs. With 11,000+ people in 35 countries, our global portfolio includes assets across the Americas, Europe, Africa, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We trade with over 50 nations, while providing farmers unique direct access to the growing Chinese market.

Job Purpose

Position is part of the global Operational Risk team.

To perform analysis and reporting supporting the execution of risk-based internal control activities.

To provide information and insights to help managers and stakeholders mitigate and preempt risks in compliance with CIL Policies.

Role Objectives


To provide regular reports and analysis on subjects related to inventories and risks
To ensure global coverage of reporting, system user training and support across all time zones.
To support the Coordinator in system and data enhancements.


RESPONSIBILITIES:


Developing, creating, and managing business reports as well as ad hoc reporting
Support Operational Risk management systems (including and not limited to Inventory Risk Management System, Risk Register) and develop internal procedure requirements
Liaising with IT for system enhancements and bug fixes, testing and reviews
System data maintenance
Review user inputs and identifying data errors
User training and support
Ensure compliance of Operational Risk policies and manuals


KEY RESULT AREAS


Reliable and timely reporting
Manage data and system enhancement projects
Demonstrated ability to manage time and prioritize projects to meet deadlines


EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS


University education
Excellent command of English (spoken and written), Portuguese a plus
Analytical skills allow for the development of data-driven reports
Ability to interact and communicate internally as well as externally with different stakeholders and different nationalities
Detail- oriented and probem-solver
High level of common sense, creativity and innovation
Able to work and deliver under pressure
Self-starter and able to work both as a team and independently


TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE


Advanced knowledge in Excel including Power Pivots, Power Query
Knowledge of BI software, preferably QlikSense or PowerBI
Knowledge of programing knowledge such VBA, Power BI and Power Query
Database knowledge such as SQL
Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Title: E-commerce Trading & Business Analyst
HTML:
O e-commerce da hôma está em plena evolução — e queremos integrar um(a) E-Commerce Trading & Business Analyst!

O objetivo é transformar dados em decisões comerciais, potenciando o crescimento do negócio digital. O reporte será ao Commercial & Operations Manager, com quem trabalhará em estreita colaboração para otimizar a performance comercial, definir estratégias de pricing e garantir a excelência na execução das campanhas e iniciativas do e-commerce.

Missão: Impulsionar a performance comercial do e-commerce através da análise de dados, garantindo que campanhas, promoções e decisões de pricing são baseadas em informação e bem executadas. Em síntese: transformar dados em ações que aumentam receita, protegem margem e melhoram a experiência do cliente.

O que será o teu dia a dia…

  • Monitorizar indicadores de performance comercial (GMV, margem, AOV, conversão e sell-through), identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo ações de otimização;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar dashboards e scorecards que apoiem a tomada de decisão da equipa;
  • Definir recomendações de pricing competitivo e estratégias promocionais alinhadas com os objetivos de negócio;
  • Criar e acompanhar campanhas comerciais, analisando o seu impacto e retorno;
  • Participar na construção do calendário comercial e garantir a execução operacional das campanhas;
  • Assegurar a validação de preços, stocks, mecânicas promocionais, landing pages e comunicação antes de cada lançamento;
  • Avaliar os resultados das campanhas e identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua.
  • Acompanhar a performance dos parceiros de dropshipping, promovendo o crescimento da oferta online e monitorizando a experiência do cliente;
  • Colaborar com equipas multidisciplinares para garantir a melhor execução das iniciativas comerciais.

O que vamos valorizar no teu perfil…

  • Formação superior em Gestão, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing ou áreas similares;
  • Experiência em funções de análise comercial, trading ou e-commerce;
  • Experiência em plataformas de e-commerce (valorizada experiência em Salesforce Commerce Cloud);
  • Conhecimentos de métricas comerciais, pricing e estratégias promocionais;
  • Domínio avançado de Excel;
  • Conhecimentos de ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Looker Studio ou GA4);
  • Forte capacidade analítica e orientação para resultados;
  • Organização, atenção ao detalhe e capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e colaboração transversal.

Se procuras um desafio onde possas transformar dados em impacto real no negócio e contribuir diretamente para a performance do e-commerce, queremos conhecer-te!

Title: Business Intelligence /Data Analytics Engineer Trainee (IEFP)
Description:
Join us as a Business Intelligence /Data Analytics Engineer Trainee!

As a Business Intelligence /Data analytics Engineer Trainee you will design, build, and maintain scalable analytics solutions that transform raw data into actionable insights. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to deliver reliable data models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that support strategic and operational decision-making.

Key Accountabilities

You will primarily be responsible for:


Assist in collecting, cleaning, transforming, and validating data from multiple sources.
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, anomalies, and business insights.
Develop and evaluate machine learning models for supervised and unsupervised learning tasks.
Prepare datasets for statistical analysis and predictive modelling.
Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and best practices in data engineering, analytics, and data science.
Designing and maintaining semantic data models (star/snowflake schemas) optimized for analytics and reporting.
Building and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines from multiple data sources, ensuring data quality and consistency.
Ensure data quality, consistency and performance across business intelligence solutions.
Developing and maintaining dashboards and reports using BI tools such as Power BI, Python and R.
Translating business requirements into robust BI solutions and flexible Power BI semantic models.
Optimizing SQL queries, data models and report performance for large-scale datasets, monitoring BI workloads in cloud and on-premises environments.
Collaborating with business users to understand KPIs, metrics and reporting needs, and partnering with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and Product teams.
Providing guidance and best practices to analysts and report developers.
Defining and enforcing data standards, naming conventions and documentation, supporting data lineage and metadata management.
Ensuring compliance with security and privacy requirements.


Knowledge, Skills And Experience Required


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering or related fields.
Eligible for an IEFP Level VI Internship.
Good programming skills; knowledge of python, C#.
Machine learning model development and evaluation.
Data wrangling using libraries such as Pandas/Modin, Polars, NumPy.
Knowledge of multiple databases such as SQLServer, PostgreSQL, DuckDB.
API-based data ingestion.
Strong SQL skills and experience with data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Big Query, Redshift, SQL Server).
Hands-on with Power BI (semantic models, DAX, DirectQuery) and ETL/ELT tools (SSIS, ADF, Airflow, dbt, SSIS or similar).
Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and Azure Foundry (Nice to have).
Knowledge of data modelling techniques (Kimball, dimensional modelling).
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate business needs into data models and KPIs.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Organized, able to manage multiple priorities and share knowledge effectively.
Fluent in English, with good verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
Nice to have: experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), Python, DevOps/CI-CD for BI, data governance frameworks.


Apply by submitting your CV in English.

Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

This role ensures the accuracy, security, and accessibility of HR data across systems, collaborates with key stakeholders to align reporting capabilities with business needs, and drives continuous improvement in data reporting, visualization, and analytics.

Oversee the collection, organization, and validation of HR data across multiple platforms to ensure accuracy and integrity. Develop and maintain HR dashboards, reports, and analytics tools that provide high-quality, actionable insights to support decision-making at all levels.
Partner with HR leadership and the HRIS team to align reporting and analytics strategies with broader HR and business goals, ensuring that reporting capabilities meet evolving organizational needs and support workforce planning, performance metrics, and other strategic initiatives.
Work closely with IT, Digital, and HR teams to enhance data integration, improve reporting processes, and ensure data accessibility. Act as the primary liaison for data analytics-related initiatives, promoting a data-driven culture within HR.
Identify and implement improvements to reporting and analytics processes, leveraging new tools, technology, and best practices to enhance data-driven decision-making across HR functions. Drive the adoption of advanced analytics techniques to anticipate trends and support predictive insights.
Ensure all HR data management and reporting practices adhere to internal governance standards, regulatory requirements, and data privacy regulations, and other applicable laws.

Title: Market Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Market Intelligence Analyst (Associate/Mid-Level/Senior)

Market Intelligence Analyst (Associate/Mid-Level/Senior)

Who We Are

FedEx is the world’s largest express transportation company, connecting more than 220 countries and territories and supporting businesses across global markets. Innovation, operational excellence, and customer insight are at the core of how we grow, compete, and create value. As market dynamics evolve, strong intelligence capabilities are critical to helping the business anticipate change, understand competitive threats, and identify new opportunities.

To support this, we are looking for a Market Intelligence Analyst to strengthen our strategic intelligence capability across Europe.

Role

As a Market Intelligence Analyst, you will play a central role in helping FedEx understand the competitive landscape and broader market environment across the European CEP and freight sectors. The role combines quantitative analysis, market research, and executive storytelling. A significant part of the job will involve tracking market developments, analyzing competitor performance, sizing markets, building forecasts, and translating findings into clear and relevant business updates.

This is a high-impact role for someone who is analytically strong, commercially aware, and comfortable turning complex information into concise insights for decision-makers.

What You Will Do

Level depends on the candidate skills and experience.

You will monitor competitor moves and market developments, including earnings releases, annual reports, external intelligence sources, and broader economic or trade shifts. You will build a clear view of what is happening in the market, what it means for FedEx, and where risks or opportunities may emerge.

You will also support market sizing and forecasting work across the European CEP and freight landscape, helping the business understand the size, shape, and future direction of the market. In addition, the role will contribute to strategic and high-impact projects, including scenario planning, strategy framing, and selected business cases.

Key Responsibilities


Develop market sizing analyses for the European CEP and freight sectors, including segment-level views and growth outlooks.
Re-engineer and improve models, tools, and analytical approaches that strengthen strategic decision-making and communication to senior leadership.
Monitor competitor activity and market developments across Europe, including earnings, financial disclosures, industry reports, quarterly and annual market sizing, and other relevant intelligence sources.
Analyze competitor strategies, market movements, and external signals to identify risks, opportunities, and implications for FedEx.
Build market forecasts and support proactive scenario planning around macroeconomic shifts, trade changes, and evolving customer demand.
Prepare regular executive updates and presentations that synthesize intelligence into clear, relevant, and actionable insights.
Drive the development of competitive intelligence capabilities by improving frameworks, strengthening internal collaboration networks, and connecting with stakeholders across regions and functions.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure intelligence is translated into business action and incorporated into planning discussions.


What We Are Looking For

This role would suit a candidate with strong analytical depth, sound business judgment, and the ability to work comfortably between data, research, and executive communication. The successful candidate should be highly numerate and detail-oriented, but also able to step back, interpret the broader picture, and communicate it in a compelling way.

Experience in competitive intelligence, strategic planning, consulting, or a similar business analysis environment would be highly relevant. Knowledge of transportation, logistics, freight, or parcel markets would be a strong advantage.

Skills And Experience


Excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills; comfortable building presentations for senior and executive audiences.
University degree or business school background.
Around 5 years of relevant professional experience in market intelligence, strategic planning, consulting, business analysis, or a related field.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work confidently with quantitative data and convert it into meaningful business insights.
Experience monitoring competitors, tracking earnings, assessing market dynamics, and developing strategic recommendations.
Strong business acumen and general commercial logic, ideally with knowledge of the transportation or logistics industry.
Ability to conduct structured market research and develop market sizing, forecasting, and scenario-based analyses.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly and credibly in English.
Proven ability to lead or contribute to high-impact cross-functional projects.
Strong planning and organizational skills, with the flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and ambiguous situations.
Comfortable working across functions, regions, and different levels of seniority in a matrix environment.
Experience with virtual collaboration tools such as Teams, Planner, or Mural is a plus.
Prior experience in competitive intelligence, strategic planning, or consulting is particularly valuable.


Why join us

This is an opportunity to work on topics that are directly connected to FedEx’s competitive position and long-term direction in Europe. The role offers a strong mix of analysis, strategy, and senior stakeholder exposure, and would suit someone who enjoys combining numbers, research, and business storytelling in a meaningful way.

It is also a role with room to shape and improve how intelligence is built and used across the organization — making it a strong fit for someone who wants both impact and visibility.

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce in which we provide growth opportunities for all

Our Company

FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

Our Philosophy

The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.

Our Culture

Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

Market Intelligence Analyst (Associate/Mid-Level/Senior)

Who We Are

FedEx is the world’s largest express transportation company, connecting more than 220 countries and territories and supporting businesses across global markets. Innovation, operational excellence, and customer insight are at the core of how we grow, compete, and create value. As market dynamics evolve, strong intelligence capabilities are critical to helping the business anticipate change, understand competitive threats, and identify new opportunities.

To support this, we are looking for a Market Intelligence Analyst to strengthen our strategic intelligence capability across Europe.

Role

As a Market Intelligence Analyst, you will play a central role in helping FedEx understand the competitive landscape and broader market environment across the European CEP and freight sectors. The role combines quantitative analysis, market research, and executive storytelling. A significant part of the job will involve tracking market developments, analyzing competitor performance, sizing markets, building forecasts, and translating findings into clear and relevant business updates.

This is a high-impact role for someone who is analytically strong, commercially aware, and comfortable turning complex information into concise insights for decision-makers.

What You Will Do

Level depends on the candidate skills and experience.

You will monitor competitor moves and market developments, including earnings releases, annual reports, external intelligence sources, and broader economic or trade shifts. You will build a clear view of what is happening in the market, what it means for FedEx, and where risks or opportunities may emerge.

You will also support market sizing and forecasting work across the European CEP and freight landscape, helping the business understand the size, shape, and future direction of the market. In addition, the role will contribute to strategic and high-impact projects, including scenario planning, strategy framing, and selected business cases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop market sizing analyses for the European CEP and freight sectors, including segment-level views and growth outlooks.
  • Re-engineer and improve models, tools, and analytical approaches that strengthen strategic decision-making and communication to senior leadership.
  • Monitor competitor activity and market developments across Europe, including earnings, financial disclosures, industry reports, quarterly and annual market sizing, and other relevant intelligence sources.
  • Analyze competitor strategies, market movements, and external signals to identify risks, opportunities, and implications for FedEx.
  • Build market forecasts and support proactive scenario planning around macroeconomic shifts, trade changes, and evolving customer demand.
  • Prepare regular executive updates and presentations that synthesize intelligence into clear, relevant, and actionable insights.
  • Drive the development of competitive intelligence capabilities by improving frameworks, strengthening internal collaboration networks, and connecting with stakeholders across regions and functions.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure intelligence is translated into business action and incorporated into planning discussions.

What We Are Looking For

This role would suit a candidate with strong analytical depth, sound business judgment, and the ability to work comfortably between data, research, and executive communication. The successful candidate should be highly numerate and detail-oriented, but also able to step back, interpret the broader picture, and communicate it in a compelling way.

Experience in competitive intelligence, strategic planning, consulting, or a similar business analysis environment would be highly relevant. Knowledge of transportation, logistics, freight, or parcel markets would be a strong advantage.

Skills And Experience

  • Excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills; comfortable building presentations for senior and executive audiences.
  • University degree or business school background.
  • Around 5 years of relevant professional experience in market intelligence, strategic planning, consulting, business analysis, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work confidently with quantitative data and convert it into meaningful business insights.
  • Experience monitoring competitors, tracking earnings, assessing market dynamics, and developing strategic recommendations.
  • Strong business acumen and general commercial logic, ideally with knowledge of the transportation or logistics industry.
  • Ability to conduct structured market research and develop market sizing, forecasting, and scenario-based analyses.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly and credibly in English.
  • Proven ability to lead or contribute to high-impact cross-functional projects.
  • Strong planning and organizational skills, with the flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and ambiguous situations.
  • Comfortable working across functions, regions, and different levels of seniority in a matrix environment.
  • Experience with virtual collaboration tools such as Teams, Planner, or Mural is a plus.
  • Prior experience in competitive intelligence, strategic planning, or consulting is particularly valuable.

Why join us

This is an opportunity to work on topics that are directly connected to FedEx’s competitive position and long-term direction in Europe. The role offers a strong mix of analysis, strategy, and senior stakeholder exposure, and would suit someone who enjoys combining numbers, research, and business storytelling in a meaningful way.

It is also a role with room to shape and improve how intelligence is built and used across the organization — making it a strong fit for someone who wants both impact and visibility.

Title: Senior Data Business Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI
Description:
Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

Natixis in Portugal is currently seeking a Senior Data Business Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI to join its BPCE SI (BPCE Solutions Informatiques) team, within the IT (Information Technologies) department, to work in a hybrid work model in the Porto office, to join a data team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business requirements and our Data teams (Data Engineers, Data Analysts). To succeed in this mission, you will not just gather requirements: you will actively dive into the data by writing queries and analyzing our Oracle database tables to understand their structure, quality, and underlying logic.

Key Responsibilities


Write SQL queries to directly query and analyze tables within our database.
Explore and profile raw data to understand its structure, underlying business rules, and to identify potential anomalies.
Work closely with Data teams (Data Engineers, BI, and Analytics) to translate functional business rules into technical requirements.
Draft clear functional and technical specifications (source-to-target data mapping).
Assist business stakeholders in defining their requirements by providing a realistic view of the data actually available in the Oracle systems.
Design and execute test plans (both functional and technical data reconciliation).


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL (Essential): Strong ability to write complex queries (JOINs, subqueries, analytical functions, etc.) to query databases.
5+ years of solid experience as business analyst.
Oracle Environment: Proven experience working with Oracle databases (using tools such as PL/SQL Developer, TOAD, DBeaver, or SQL Developer).
Data Analysis: Ability to analyze data models (tables, views, primary/foreign keys).
Data Modeling: Basic understanding of data architecture concepts (Data Warehouse, Data Marts).
French: Minimum C1 level (fluent/advanced) is required, as you will interact closely with French-speaking business stakeholders and write functional specifications in French. A good level of English is also required.


We will only consider CVs in English.

Additional Information

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Scientists and Analysts work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. We’re looking for Graduate Data Scientists and Analysts who are analytical, curious, and ready to deliver impact with data.

Key dates


Applications: open from May 2026
Recruitment process: July–December 2026

Roles are filled on a rolling basis, so apply early. You can specify your preferred intake during the recruitment process.

Taking part in a hands-on bootcamp and working on real projects across multiple teams

Enhancing and maintaining data infrastructure (including ETLs and LookML) to keep data accessible and reliable
Collaborating with teams across Operations, Growth, and Product to refine features and uncover insights

Managing tasks, tracking progress, and communicating key outcomes
Sharing updates with our global teams
Receiving regular feedback to guide your development


What You'll Need


A predicted or achieved 2:1 (or equivalent grade) in computer science, maths, physics, or a related field
To have graduated in 2025, 2026, or 2027
Impressive Python and SQL skills
A solid foundation in maths and statistics
An interest in analytics engineering, product analytics, data science, or ML engineering
Great problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset
Fluency in English and excellent communication skills

Deliver accurate and timely People Analytics reports, analyses, and dashboards, applying established global and regional methodologies, templates, and standards.

Master's degree or equivalent education.

Title: Operational Risk Analyst - Data and Reporting
Description:
COFCO International is a global agri-business with a clear vision, strong values and a positive culture, focused on being a leader in the global grains, oilseeds and sugar supply chains. We provide the food the world needs in a responsible way. Headquartered is Geneva, Switzerland, we are ambitious, with the right structures and culture to meet the world's increasing and changing needs. With 11,000+ people in 35 countries, our global portfolio includes assets across the Americas, Europe, Africa, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We trade with over 50 nations, while providing farmers unique direct access to the growing Chinese market.

Job Purpose

Position is part of the global Operational Risk team.

To perform analysis and reporting supporting the execution of risk-based internal control activities.

To provide information and insights to help managers and stakeholders mitigate and preempt risks in compliance with CIL Policies.

Role Objectives


To provide regular reports and analysis on subjects related to inventories and risks
To ensure global coverage of reporting, system user training and support across all time zones.
To support the Coordinator in system and data enhancements.


RESPONSIBILITIES:


Developing, creating, and managing business reports as well as ad hoc reporting
Support Operational Risk management systems (including and not limited to Inventory Risk Management System, Risk Register) and develop internal procedure requirements
Liaising with IT for system enhancements and bug fixes, testing and reviews
System data maintenance
Review user inputs and identifying data errors
User training and support
Ensure compliance of Operational Risk policies and manuals


KEY RESULT AREAS


Reliable and timely reporting
Manage data and system enhancement projects
Demonstrated ability to manage time and prioritize projects to meet deadlines


EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS


University education
Excellent command of English (spoken and written), Portuguese a plus
Analytical skills allow for the development of data-driven reports
Ability to interact and communicate internally as well as externally with different stakeholders and different nationalities
Detail- oriented and probem-solver
High level of common sense, creativity and innovation
Able to work and deliver under pressure
Self-starter and able to work both as a team and independently


TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE


Advanced knowledge in Excel including Power Pivots, Power Query
Knowledge of BI software, preferably QlikSense or PowerBI
Knowledge of programing knowledge such VBA, Power BI and Power Query
Database knowledge such as SQL
Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Title: Market Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Market Intelligence Analyst (Associate/Mid-Level/Senior)

Market Intelligence Analyst (Associate/Mid-Level/Senior)

Who We Are

FedEx is the world’s largest express transportation company, connecting more than 220 countries and territories and supporting businesses across global markets. Innovation, operational excellence, and customer insight are at the core of how we grow, compete, and create value. As market dynamics evolve, strong intelligence capabilities are critical to helping the business anticipate change, understand competitive threats, and identify new opportunities.

To support this, we are looking for a Market Intelligence Analyst to strengthen our strategic intelligence capability across Europe.

Role

As a Market Intelligence Analyst, you will play a central role in helping FedEx understand the competitive landscape and broader market environment across the European CEP and freight sectors. The role combines quantitative analysis, market research, and executive storytelling. A significant part of the job will involve tracking market developments, analyzing competitor performance, sizing markets, building forecasts, and translating findings into clear and relevant business updates.

This is a high-impact role for someone who is analytically strong, commercially aware, and comfortable turning complex information into concise insights for decision-makers.

What You Will Do

Level depends on the candidate skills and experience.

You will monitor competitor moves and market developments, including earnings releases, annual reports, external intelligence sources, and broader economic or trade shifts. You will build a clear view of what is happening in the market, what it means for FedEx, and where risks or opportunities may emerge.

You will also support market sizing and forecasting work across the European CEP and freight landscape, helping the business understand the size, shape, and future direction of the market. In addition, the role will contribute to strategic and high-impact projects, including scenario planning, strategy framing, and selected business cases.

Key Responsibilities


Develop market sizing analyses for the European CEP and freight sectors, including segment-level views and growth outlooks.
Re-engineer and improve models, tools, and analytical approaches that strengthen strategic decision-making and communication to senior leadership.
Monitor competitor activity and market developments across Europe, including earnings, financial disclosures, industry reports, quarterly and annual market sizing, and other relevant intelligence sources.
Analyze competitor strategies, market movements, and external signals to identify risks, opportunities, and implications for FedEx.
Build market forecasts and support proactive scenario planning around macroeconomic shifts, trade changes, and evolving customer demand.
Prepare regular executive updates and presentations that synthesize intelligence into clear, relevant, and actionable insights.
Drive the development of competitive intelligence capabilities by improving frameworks, strengthening internal collaboration networks, and connecting with stakeholders across regions and functions.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure intelligence is translated into business action and incorporated into planning discussions.


What We Are Looking For

This role would suit a candidate with strong analytical depth, sound business judgment, and the ability to work comfortably between data, research, and executive communication. The successful candidate should be highly numerate and detail-oriented, but also able to step back, interpret the broader picture, and communicate it in a compelling way.

Experience in competitive intelligence, strategic planning, consulting, or a similar business analysis environment would be highly relevant. Knowledge of transportation, logistics, freight, or parcel markets would be a strong advantage.

Skills And Experience


Excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills; comfortable building presentations for senior and executive audiences.
University degree or business school background.
Around 5 years of relevant professional experience in market intelligence, strategic planning, consulting, business analysis, or a related field.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work confidently with quantitative data and convert it into meaningful business insights.
Experience monitoring competitors, tracking earnings, assessing market dynamics, and developing strategic recommendations.
Strong business acumen and general commercial logic, ideally with knowledge of the transportation or logistics industry.
Ability to conduct structured market research and develop market sizing, forecasting, and scenario-based analyses.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly and credibly in English.
Proven ability to lead or contribute to high-impact cross-functional projects.
Strong planning and organizational skills, with the flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and ambiguous situations.
Comfortable working across functions, regions, and different levels of seniority in a matrix environment.
Experience with virtual collaboration tools such as Teams, Planner, or Mural is a plus.
Prior experience in competitive intelligence, strategic planning, or consulting is particularly valuable.


Why join us

This is an opportunity to work on topics that are directly connected to FedEx’s competitive position and long-term direction in Europe. The role offers a strong mix of analysis, strategy, and senior stakeholder exposure, and would suit someone who enjoys combining numbers, research, and business storytelling in a meaningful way.

It is also a role with room to shape and improve how intelligence is built and used across the organization — making it a strong fit for someone who wants both impact and visibility.

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce in which we provide growth opportunities for all

Our Company

FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

Our Philosophy

The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.

Our Culture

Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

Equity, Opportunity & Diversity (EO&D)

Our greatest asset at FedEx is our people. We are committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, and offer equal opportunities, fairness, and respect to all regardless of who you are. We encourage you to apply even if you feel your experience does not align with all aspects in the job description as you could be exactly who we need for this or another opportunity.

We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, age, genetic information, citizenship, disability, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other characteristic protected under international and national laws and regulations. We reasonably accommodate team members and third parties to ensure equal access, inclusion, and fairness across all protected characteristics.

Title: Data Collection Analyst (Performance Data)
Description:
Overview

Stats Perform is the market leader in sports tech.  We provide the most trusted sports data to some of the world's biggest organizations, across sports, media, and broadcasting.  

Through the latest AI technologies and machine learning, we combine decades' worth of data with the latest in-game happenings. We then offer coaches, teams, professional bodies, and media channels around the world, access to the very best data, content, and insights.  In turn, improving how sports fans interact with their favourite sports teams and competitions.

How do we add value?


Media outlets add a little magic to their coverage with our stats and graphics packages.
Sportsbooks can offer better predictions and more accurate odds.
The world's top coaches are known to use our data to make critical team decisions.
Sports commentators can engage with fans on a deeper level, using our stories and insights.


Anywhere you find sport, Stats Perform is there.  However, data and tech are only half of the package. We need great people to fuel the engine.

We succeeded thanks to a team of amazing people. They spend their days collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data from a wide range of live sporting events. If you combine this real-time data with our 40-year-old archives, elite journalists, camera operators, copywriters, the latest in AI wizardry, and a host of 'behind the scenes' support staff, you've got all the ingredients to make it a magical experience!

Responsibilities


WHAT’S YOUR NEW ROLE ABOUT?
Deliver live coverage within our highest standard measures.
Post-match checks applied through the correct guideline procedures.
Expert knowledge in Performance soccer definitions and processes.
Adept at making carefully considered decisions having consulted stakeholders and weighed up


risks with minimal delays.


High knowledge in betting games processes and definitions.
Responsibility for freelancers: support on re-training, definitions and help to improve KPIs.


Required Qualifications:


DO YOU HAVE THESE ESSENTIALS?
Experience as Soccer Performance Analyst.
Excellent organization and communication skills.
English skills.
Complete understanding of collection tools and processes.
Specialist knowledge of worldwide soccer leagues and competition


Desired Qualifications:


IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAD THESE DESIRABLES TOO
Spanish and Portuguese Skills and other languages.
Specialist knowledge of worldwide soccer leagues and competitions.
Organizes own and teamwork by taking into account deadlines and following the established


procedures.


Working collaboratively with a group of people in order to accomplish a task or achieve a goal.


Treats all team members in a respectful, courteous and professional manner; supports team

despite different points of views or setbacks.


Ability to engage and enable people to perform at their best.
Self–motivated and driven to succeed, focused on results and passionate about the job.
On-going learning and development and ability to apply new knowledge.
Ability to adapt to changing business needs, cultures, conditions and work responsibilities.


Why work at Stats Perform?

We love sports, but we love diverse thinking more!

We know that diversity brings creativity, so we invite people from all backgrounds to join us.  At Stats Perform you can make a difference, by using your skills and experience every day, you'll feel valued and respected for your contribution.  

We take care of our colleagues

We like happy and healthy colleagues. You will benefit from things like Mental Health Days Off, ‘No Meeting Fridays,’ and flexible working schedules.

We pull together to build a better workplace and world for all.

We encourage employees to take part in charitable activities, utilize their 2 days of Volunteering Time Off, support our environmental efforts, and be actively involved in Employee Resource Groups.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Stats Perform

By joining Stats Perform, you'll be part of a team that celebrates diversity. A team that is dedicated to creating an inclusive atmosphere where everyone feels valued and welcome. All employees are collectively responsible for developing and maintaining an inclusive environment. That is why our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals underpin our core values.

With increased diversity comes increased innovation and creativity. Ensuring we're best placed to serve our clients and communities. Stats Perform is committed to seeking diversity, equity, and inclusion in all we do.

At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need - and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across Musculoskeletal, Women’s Health, Cardiometabolic, and Mental Health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 1 million members across three continents have completed over 15 million AI sessions, helping 2,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 59 clinical studies, 43 patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

Role
We are looking for a highly technical, forward-thinking Marketing Operations Lead to own the systems, data, and automation backbone of our B2B Marketing engine. In this role, you will be the technical architect of our marketing stack, translating business needs into robust configurations and data pipelines.

You don’t need to be an AI engineer today, but you are hungry to become one. This role is designed for a skilled ops professional who wants to step on the career gas pedal and act as our team’s AI Amplifier and be positioned to be a GTM Ops leader or GTM engineer in the future. We will give you the runway and the modern stack to evaluate, build, and maintain cutting-edge, AI-driven workflows that supercharge our productivity.

While this is a deeply technical, hands-on role, it is also a leadership launchpad. You will need the cross-functional influence and emotional intelligence to work alongside Marketing, Commercial, and Data teams—ensuring the high-leverage tools you build are actually adopted and drive real business impact. If you are a master of the core GTM stack and eager to master the next generation of AI-ops, this is your sandbox.

AI Proficiency at Sword Health
AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword Health. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.



Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity
Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team
Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale





Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

What you'll be doing:


Data Ops & Reporting
End-to-End Analytics & Funnel Ownership: Own B2B marketing data pipelines, SQL queries, dashboarding, and performance reporting across the entire marketing funnel.
Performance Tracking: Build and maintain frameworks to report on key performance metrics, such as marketing-qualified lead (MQL) volumes, sales-qualified opportunity (SQO) conversions, and campaign-level ROI.
Attribution Integrity: Manage attribution modeling and data tracking (e.g., Bizible, Salesforce) to accurately measure and prove marketing's impact on pipeline generation.
Cross-Functional Data Collaboration: Partner closely with the core data team to ensure clean, structured data syncs and self-serve dashboarding capabilities.
Tech Stack Configurations
Marketing Automation & CRM Administration: Act as the technical administrator for HubSpot and Salesforce, managing syncs, campaign configurations, list segmentation, and form integrations.
Web & Content Operations Support: Own backend configurations for our web properties (e.g., Storyblok) to ensure seamless data flow from landing pages into the CRM.
System Health & Governance: Establish and enforce processes for database cleanliness, lead-routing logic, and campaign naming conventions to maintain platform integrity.
Automations & Internal Tooling (The "AI Amplifier")
Build & Maintain Intelligent Workflows: Design and optimize workflows using n8n, Clay, and Claude Code to automate lead enrichment, ICP classification, and persona mapping.
Internal AI Product Development: Identify opportunities and act as the “product owner” for internal AI tools (e.g., custom objection intelligence applications, RFP bots, or custom LLM integrations) to maximize team effectiveness.





What you need to have:


The Technical Stack: You have hands-on, expert-level experience configuring and administering HubSpot and/or Salesforce.
The Automation Stack: You have some experience building multi-step automations and workflows using iPaaS tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, or n8n). Most importantly, you have an insatiable curiosity for AI, API integrations, and modern data enrichment (e.g., Clay), and are excited to rapidly upskill in these technologies.
Analytical Mindset: Strong proficiency with SQL, BI tools, and marketing attribution software.
Cross-Functional Leadership: You aren't just a builder; you have the leadership skills, communication clarity, and emotional intelligence to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive adoption of your tools.
Action-Oriented Problem Solver: You thrive in fast-paced environments, actively looking for manual bottlenecks to solve through smart automation.
This range includes base, variable and equity





These compensation bands are just the starting point. Once someone joins and proves they’re outlier talent, we adjust quickly to ensure their compensation aligns with their impact.

Our job titles may span more than one career level. Actual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, location, market demand, and other factors. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base salary and any potential variable, bonus or sales incentives, and the Company’s estimation of the value of private company stock options, if applicable. The pay range is subject to change, future value of company stock options is not guaranteed, and compensation may be modified in the future. In addition to our total compensation, Sword offers a number of benefits as listed below.

Health, dental and vision insurance
Meal allowance
Equity shares
Remote work allowance
Flexible working hours
Work from home
Discretionary vacation
Snacks and beverages





Note: Please note that this position does not offer relocation assistance. Candidates must possess a valid EU visa and be based in Portugal.
